2.15.s:
2.71
rāma uvāca ..
daṇḍapraṇayanārthāya rājā sṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā ..
devabhāgānupādāya sarvabhūtābhiguptaye .. .. 1 ..
2.15.d:
2.71
राम उवाच ॥
दण्डप्रणयनार्थाय राजा सृष्टः स्वयंभुवा ॥
देवभागानुपादाय सर्वभूताभिगुप्तये ॥ ॥ 1 ॥
2.15.m:
2.71
Rāma said: / The king was created by the Self-born for the sake of inflicting punishment, / taking parts from the gods for the protection of all beings.

2.15.s:
tejasā yadayaṃ kaścinnaiva śaknoti vīkṣitum ..
tadā bhavati lokeṣu rājā bhāskaravatprabhuḥ .. 2 ..
2.15.d:
तेजसा यदयं कश्चिन्नैव शक्नोति वीक्षितुम् ॥
तदा भवति लोकेषु राजा भास्करवत्प्रभुः ॥ 2 ॥
2.15.m: When, through his splendor, no one is able even to look upon him, / then in the worlds the lordly king becomes like the sun.

2.15.s:
yadasya darśane lokaḥ prasādamupagacchati ..
nayanānandakāritvāttadā bhavati candramāḥ .. 3 ..
2.15.d:
यदस्य दर्शने लोकः प्रसादमुपगच्छति ॥
नयनानन्दकारित्वात्तदा भवति चन्द्रमाः ॥ 3 ॥
2.15.m: When, at the sight of him, the world experiences delight / because he brings joy to the eyes, then he is the moon.

2.15.s:
cārairyadāyaṃ vyāpnoti sarvalokaṃ yadṛcchayā ..
tadā bhavati lokeṣu rājā devaḥ samīraṇaḥ .. 4 ..
2.15.d:
चारैर्यदायं व्याप्नोति सर्वलोकं यदृच्छया ॥
तदा भवति लोकेषु राजा देवः समीरणः ॥ 4 ॥
2.15.m: When through spies he pervades the entire world at will, / then in the worlds the king is the god Wind.

2.15.s:
yadā'parādhināṃ caiva vidhatte nigrahaṃ nṛpaḥ ..
tadā bhavati lokeṣu rājā vaivasvataḥ sadā .. 5 ..
2.15.d:
यदाऽपराधिनां चैव विधत्ते निग्रहं नृपः ॥
तदा भवति लोकेषु राजा वैवस्वतः सदा ॥ 5 ॥
2.15.m: And when the king executes restraint upon wrongdoers, / then in the worlds he is ever Vaivasvata.

2.15.s:
yadā bhavati māhātmyātkruddhabuddhānnarānnṛpaḥ ..
anicchannapi lokeṣu tadā bhavati pāvakaḥ .. 6 ..
2.15.d:
यदा भवति माहात्म्यात्क्रुद्धबुद्धान्नरान्नृपः ॥
अनिच्छन्नपि लोकेषु तदा भवति पावकः ॥ 6 ॥
2.15.m: When, by reason of his majesty, the king [burns] men whose minds are enraged, / even against his will, then in the worlds he is Fire.

2.15.s:
karoti ca yadā dānaṃ dhanānāṃ sarvato nṛpaḥ ..
visargārthaṃ suraśreṣṭha tadā bhavati vittadaḥ .. 7 ..
2.15.d:
करोति च यदा दानं धनानां सर्वतो नृपः ॥
विसर्गार्थं सुरश्रेष्ठ तदा भवति वित्तदः ॥ 7 ॥
2.15.m: And when the king everywhere bestows gifts of wealth / for the purpose of distribution, O best of gods, then he is the Bestower of Wealth.

2.15.s:
yadā ca dhanadhārābhirvarṣanplāvayate jagat ..
tadā sa varuṇaḥ prokto rājā nayaviśāradaiḥ .. 8 ..
2.15.d:
यदा च धनधाराभिर्वर्षन्प्लावयते जगत् ॥
तदा स वरुणः प्रोक्तो राजा नयविशारदैः ॥ 8 ॥
2.15.m: And when he floods the world, raining down streams of wealth, / then that king is declared to be Varuṇa by those learned in policy.

2.15.s:
kṣamā balena manasā dhārayansakalāḥ prajāḥ ..
aviśeṣeṇa dharmajña pārthivaḥ pārthivo bhavet .. 9 ..
2.15.d:
क्षमा बलेन मनसा धारयन्सकलाः प्रजाः ॥
अविशेषेण धर्मज्ञ पार्थिवः पार्थिवो भवेत् ॥ 9 ॥
2.15.m: Supporting all subjects impartially with forbearance, strength, and mind, / O knower of dharma, the earthly ruler becomes the Earth.

2.15.s:
yadādhipatyena janānsamagrānparirakṣati ..
tadā bhavati devendraḥ sarvabhūtānukampitā ..2.71.10..
2.15.d:
यदाधिपत्येन जनान्समग्रान्परिरक्षति ॥
तदा भवति देवेन्द्रः सर्वभूतानुकम्पिता ॥2.71.10॥
2.15.m: When through his sovereign power he protects all the people, / then, compassionate toward all beings, he is the Lord of the Gods.

2.15.s:
utsāhamaṃtraśaktiryā prabhuśaktiśca daivikī ..
catasraḥ śaktayastatra vaiṣṇavyaḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 11 ..
2.15.d:
उत्साहमंत्रशक्तिर्या प्रभुशक्तिश्च दैविकी ॥
चतस्रः शक्तयस्तत्र वैष्णव्यः परिकीर्तिताः ॥ 11 ॥
2.15.m: The energy of enthusiasm and of counsel, and divine regal power: / the powers are proclaimed there to be four, belonging to Viṣṇu.

2.15.s:
kaḥ samarthaḥ prajāḥ pātuṃ vinā vaiṣṇavatejasā ..
tisrastu śaktayastasya vaiṣṇavyaḥ pṛthivīpate .. 12 ..
2.15.d:
कः समर्थः प्रजाः पातुं विना वैष्णवतेजसा ॥
तिस्रस्तु शक्तयस्तस्य वैष्णव्यः पृथिवीपते ॥ 12 ॥
2.15.m: Who is capable of protecting subjects without the splendor of Viṣṇu? / Indeed, three are his powers, belonging to Viṣṇu, O lord of the earth.

2.15.s:
daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ samyak śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ..
kathaṃ svaviṣaye tasya daṇḍanītirbhaveddhruvā .. 13 ..
2.15.d:
दण्डप्रणयनं सम्यक् श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥
कथं स्वविषये तस्य दण्डनीतिर्भवेद्ध्रुवा ॥ 13 ॥
2.15.m: I wish to hear accurately and in truth about the proper infliction of punishment: / how the science of punishment may be firmly established in his domain,

2.15.s:
kathaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ praṇayannarendro dharmeṇa yujyedyaśasā ca vīra ..
arthena kāmena ca sa sarvametadbravīhi yādogaṇa nāthaputra .. 14 ..
2.72
puṣkara uvāca ..
daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ rāma svadeśe śṛṇu bhūbhujām ..
yasya samyakpraṇayanātsvargabhākpārthivo bhavet .. 1 ..
triyavaṃ kṛṣṇalaṃ viddhi māṣastatpañcakaṃ bhavet ..
kṛṣṇalānāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭyā karṣārdhaṃ rāma kīrtitam .. 2 ..
suvarṇaśca vinirdiṣṭo rāma ṣoḍaśamāṣakaḥ ..
niṣkaṃ suvarṇāścatvāro dharaṇaṃ daśabhistu taiḥ .. 3 ..
tāmrarūpyasuvarṇānāṃ mānametatprakīrtitam ..
tāmrakarṣāpako rāma proktaḥ kārṣāpaṇo budhaiḥ .. 4 ..
paṇānāṃ dve śate sārdhe prathamaṃ sāhasaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
madhyamaḥ pañca vijñeyaḥ sahasramapi cottamaḥ .. 5 ..
bāladāyādakaṃ rikthaṃ tāvadrājānupālayet ..
yāvatsa syātsamāvṛtto yāvadvātītaśaiśavaḥ .. 6 ..
2.15.d:
कथं च दण्डं प्रणयन्नरेन्द्रो धर्मेण युज्येद्यशसा च वीर ॥
अर्थेन कामेन च स सर्वमेतद्ब्रवीहि यादोगण नाथपुत्र ॥ 14 ॥
2.72
पुष्कर उवाच ॥
दण्डप्रणयनं राम स्वदेशे शृणु भूभुजाम् ॥
यस्य सम्यक्प्रणयनात्स्वर्गभाक्पार्थिवो भवेत् ॥ 1 ॥
त्रियवं कृष्णलं विद्धि माषस्तत्पञ्चकं भवेत् ॥
कृष्णलानां तथा षष्ट्या कर्षार्धं राम कीर्तितम् ॥ 2 ॥
सुवर्णश्च विनिर्दिष्टो राम षोडशमाषकः ॥
निष्कं सुवर्णाश्चत्वारो धरणं दशभिस्तु तैः ॥ 3 ॥
ताम्ररूप्यसुवर्णानां मानमेतत्प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
ताम्रकर्षापको राम प्रोक्तः कार्षापणो बुधैः ॥ 4 ॥
पणानां द्वे शते सार्धे प्रथमं साहसः स्मृतः ॥
मध्यमः पञ्च विज्ञेयः सहस्रमपि चोत्तमः ॥ 5 ॥
बालदायादकं रिक्थं तावद्राजानुपालयेत् ॥
यावत्स स्यात्समावृत्तो यावद्वातीतशैशवः ॥ 6 ॥
2.15.m:
and how, inflicting punishment, the king may be united with dharma, fame, / wealth, and pleasure, O hero. Tell me all this, O son of the lord of the aquatic hosts.
2.72
Puṣkara said: / Hear, O Rāma, of the infliction of punishment in their own realm by kings, / through whose proper application an earthly ruler becomes an inheritor of heaven.
Know that three barley-corns make a kṛṣṇala; five of those make a māṣa; / likewise, with sixty kṛṣṇalas, half a karṣa is declared, O Rāma.
A suvarṇa is defined as sixteen māṣas, O Rāma; / four suvarṇas make a niṣka, and ten of those make a dharaṇa.
This is declared as the measure for copper, silver, and gold. / A copper karṣa, O Rāma, is called a kārṣāpaṇa by the wise.
Two hundred and fifty paṇas is recorded as the first amercement; / the middle is to be known as five [hundred], and the highest as a thousand.
The king should protect the inherited property of a minor / until he has completed his studies or passed beyond childhood.

2.15.s:
veśyāputrāsu caivaṃ syādrakṣaṇaṃ niṣkulāsu ca ..
pativratāsu ca strīṣu vidhavāsvāturāsu ca .. 7 ..
jīvantīnāṃ tu tāsāṃ ye taddhareyuḥ svabāndhavāḥ ..
tāñśiṣyāccauradaṇḍena dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ .. 8 ..
pranaṣṭasvāmikaṃ rikthaṃ rājā tryabdaṃ nidhāpayet ..
arvāk tryabdāddharetsvāmī pareṇa nṛpatirharet .. 9 ..
mamedamiti yo brūyātso'nuyukto yathāvidhi ..
sampādya rūpasaṃkhyādīnsvāmī taddravyamarhati .. 2.72.10 ..
avedayāno naṣṭasya deśaṃ kālaṃ ca tattvataḥ ..
varṇarūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca tatsamaṃ daṇḍamarhati .. 11 ..
pranaṣṭādhigataṃ rikthaṃ tiṣṭhedarthairadhiṣṭhitam ..
yāṃstatra caurāngṛhṇīyādghātayetkuñjareṇa tān .. 12 ..
mamedamiti yo brūyādasatyenā tathā nidhim ..
tasya daṇḍaṃ haredrājā svavittasyāṣṭamāṃśakam .. 13 ..
2.15.d:
वेश्यापुत्रासु चैवं स्याद्रक्षणं निष्कुलासु च ॥
पतिव्रतासु च स्त्रीषु विधवास्वातुरासु च ॥ 7 ॥
जीवन्तीनां तु तासां ये तद्धरेयुः स्वबान्धवाः ॥
ताञ्शिष्याच्चौरदण्डेन धार्मिकः पृथिवीपतिः ॥ 8 ॥
प्रनष्टस्वामिकं रिक्थं राजा त्र्यब्दं निधापयेत् ॥
अर्वाक् त्र्यब्दाद्धरेत्स्वामी परेण नृपतिर्हरेत् ॥ 9 ॥
ममेदमिति यो ब्रूयात्सोऽनुयुक्तो यथाविधि ॥
सम्पाद्य रूपसंख्यादीन्स्वामी तद्द्रव्यमर्हति ॥ 2.72.10 ॥
अवेदयानो नष्टस्य देशं कालं च तत्त्वतः ॥
वर्णरूपं प्रमाणं च तत्समं दण्डमर्हति ॥ 11 ॥
प्रनष्टाधिगतं रिक्थं तिष्ठेदर्थैरधिष्ठितम् ॥
यांस्तत्र चौरान्गृह्णीयाद्घातयेत्कुञ्जरेण तान् ॥ 12 ॥
ममेदमिति यो ब्रूयादसत्येना तथा निधिम् ॥
तस्य दण्डं हरेद्राजा स्ववित्तस्याष्टमांशकम् ॥ 13 ॥
2.15.m:
Protection should likewise be given to sons of courtesans, to women without families, / to chaste wives, to widows, and to the diseased.
Those kinsmen who seize the property of these women while they are alive / the righteous ruler of the earth should punish with the punishment for thieves.
Property whose owner is lost the king should keep for three years; / within three years the owner may take it; after that, the king may take it.
Whoever says, 'This is mine', being questioned according to rule, / having established its form, number, and so forth, as the owner is entitled to that article.
One who does not declare the place and time of the loss in truth, / or its color, appearance, and measure, deserves a fine equal to that [property].
Property found after being lost should remain guarded by officials; / whatever thieves he catches there, he should cause to be trampled by an elephant.
If someone falsely claims of a treasure, 'This is mine,' / the king shall fine him an eighth part of his own wealth.

2.15.s:
caurairamuṣito yastu muṣito'smīti bhāṣate ..
tatpradātari bhūpāle sa daṇḍyastāvadeva tu .. 14 ..
2.15.d:
चौरैरमुषितो यस्तु मुषितोऽस्मीति भाषते ॥
तत्प्रदातरि भूपाले स दण्ड्यस्तावदेव तु ॥ 14 ॥
2.15.m: He who has not been robbed by thieves, yet says, 'I have been robbed,' / the king, when reimbursing him, shall fine him that exact amount.

2.15.s:
yo yāvannihnu tārthaṃ mithyā yo vā vadettataḥ ..
tau nṛpeṇa hyadharmajñau dāpyau taddviguṇaṃ dhanam .. 15 ..
2.15.d:
यो यावन्निह्नु तार्थं मिथ्या यो वा वदेत्ततः ॥
तौ नृपेण ह्यधर्मज्ञौ दाप्यौ तद्द्विगुणं धनम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.15.m: He who conceals an amount, or he who falsely claims from it, / both ignorant of dharma, the king must make them pay double that wealth.

2.15.s:
kūṭasākṣyaṃ tu kurvāṇāṃstrīnvarṇāndhārmiko nṛpaḥ ..
pramāpayenmahābhāga brāhmaṇaṃ tu vivāsayet .. 16 ..
2.15.d:
कूटसाक्ष्यं तु कुर्वाणांस्त्रीन्वर्णान्धार्मिको नृपः ॥
प्रमापयेन्महाभाग ब्राह्मणं तु विवासयेत् ॥ 16 ॥
2.15.m: Those of the three castes who give false testimony, the righteous king / shall execute, O fortunate one, but a brahmin he shall banish.

2.15.s:
yatsvāminānanujñātamādhiṃ bhuṅkte vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
avadhyamūlaṃ kartavyaṃ tasya daṇḍaṃ mahīkṣitā ..
vasā - - - - -tathā dharmo na hīyate .. 17 ..
2.15.d:
यत्स्वामिनाननुज्ञातमाधिं भुङ्क्ते विचक्षणः ॥
अवध्यमूलं कर्तव्यं तस्य दण्डं महीक्षिता ॥
वसा - - - - -तथा धर्मो न हीयते ॥ 17 ॥
2.15.m: When a knowledgeable man enjoys a pledge without the owner's permission, / the king should inflict a fine that does not destroy the principal; / [...] thus dharma is not diminished.

2.15.s:
yo nikṣepaṃ yācayati yaśca nikṣipya yācate ..
tāvubhau cauravacchāsyau dāpyau vā dviguṇaṃ dhanam .. 18 ..
2.15.d:
यो निक्षेपं याचयति यश्च निक्षिप्य याचते ॥
तावुभौ चौरवच्छास्यौ दाप्यौ वा द्विगुणं धनम् ॥ 18 ॥
2.15.m: He who claims a deposit [not made], and he who having deposited denies it, / both are to be punished like thieves, or made to pay double the amount.

2.15.s:
upadābhiśca yaḥ kaścitparadravyaṃ harennaraḥ ..
sasahāyaḥ sa hantavyaḥ prakāśaṃ vividhairvadhaiḥ .. 19 ..
2.15.d:
उपदाभिश्च यः कश्चित्परद्रव्यं हरेन्नरः ॥
ससहायः स हन्तव्यः प्रकाशं विविधैर्वधैः ॥ 19 ॥
2.15.m: Any man who steals another's property by bribes / should be put to death along with his accomplice publicly by various forms of execution.

2.15.s:
yo yācitakamādāya na taddadyādyathākramam ..
sa nigṛhya balāddāpyo daṇḍo vai pūrvasāhasam .. 2.72.20 ..
2.15.d:
यो याचितकमादाय न तद्दद्याद्यथाक्रमम् ॥
स निगृह्य बलाद्दाप्यो दण्डो वै पूर्वसाहसम् ॥ 2.72.20 ॥
2.15.m: He who takes a borrowed item and does not return it in due course, / having been seized, he must be forced to pay it, and the fine is indeed the first level of punishment.

2.15.s:
ajñānādyaḥ pumānkuryātparadravyasya vikrayam ..
nirdoṣo jñānaparyantaṃ cauravadvadhamarhati .. 21 ..
2.15.d:
अज्ञानाद्यः पुमान्कुर्यात्परद्रव्यस्य विक्रयम् ॥
निर्दोषो ज्ञानपर्यन्तं चौरवद्वधमर्हति ॥ 21 ॥
2.15.m: A man who sells another's property through ignorance / is guiltless up to [the point of] knowledge; [if knowingly,] he deserves death like a thief.

2.15.s:
mūlyamādāya yo vidyāṃ śilpaṃ vā na prayacchati..
daṇḍyaḥ samūlaṃ sakalaṃ dharmajñena mahīkṣitā .. 22 ..
2.15.d:
मूल्यमादाय यो विद्यां शिल्पं वा न प्रयच्छति॥
दण्ड्यः समूलं सकलं धर्मज्ञेन महीक्षिता ॥ 22 ॥
2.15.m: He who takes a fee and does not impart learning or a craft, / must be fined the whole amount together with interest by the king who knows dharma.

2.15.s:
dvijabhojye tu samprāpte prātiveśyamabhojanam ..
hiraṇyamāṣakaṃ daṇḍyaḥ pāpe nāsti hyatikramaḥ .. 23 ..
2.15.d:
द्विजभोज्ये तु सम्प्राप्ते प्रातिवेश्यमभोजनम् ॥
हिरण्यमाषकं दण्ड्यः पापे नास्ति ह्यतिक्रमः ॥ 23 ॥
2.15.m: When a feast for twice-borns is held, [a householder] not feeding a neighbor / should be fined one gold māṣaka; but there is no transgression if [the neighbor] is wicked.

2.15.s:
āmantrito dvijo yastu vartamānaḥ pratigrahe ..
niṣkāraṇaṃ na gacchedyaḥ sa dāpyo'ṣṭaśataṃ damam .. 24 ..
2.15.d:
आमन्त्रितो द्विजो यस्तु वर्तमानः प्रतिग्रहे ॥
निष्कारणं न गच्छेद्यः स दाप्योऽष्टशतं दमम् ॥ 24 ॥
2.15.m: An invited twice-born who accepts gifts, / if he does not go without cause, he should be made to pay a fine of one hundred and eight [paṇas].

2.15.s: pratiśrutyāpradātāraṃ suvarṇaṃ daṇḍayennṛpaḥ .. .. 25 ..
2.15.d: प्रतिश्रुत्याप्रदातारं सुवर्णं दण्डयेन्नृपः ॥ ॥ 25 ॥
2.15.m: One who promises but does not give, the king should fine a suvarṇa.

2.15.s:
bhṛto'nārto na kuryādyo darpātkarma yathoditam ..
sa daṇḍyaḥ kṛṣṇalānyaṣṭau na deyaṃ cāsya vetanam .. 26 ..
2.15.d:
भृतोऽनार्तो न कुर्याद्यो दर्पात्कर्म यथोदितम् ॥
स दण्ड्यः कृष्णलान्यष्टौ न देयं चास्य वेतनम् ॥ 26 ॥
2.15.m: A hired servant, not afflicted [by illness], who out of pride fails to perform the work as agreed, / shall be fined eight kṛṣṇalas, and his wages must not be paid.

2.15.s:
akāle yastyajedbhṛtyaṃ daṇḍyaḥ syāttāvadeva tu ..
yo grāmadeśasaṃghānāṃ kṛtvā satyena saṃvidam ..
visaṃvadennaro lobhāttaṃ rāṣṭrādvipravāsayet .. 27 ..
2.15.d:
अकाले यस्त्यजेद्भृत्यं दण्ड्यः स्यात्तावदेव तु ॥
यो ग्रामदेशसंघानां कृत्वा सत्येन संविदम् ॥
विसंवदेन्नरो लोभात्तं राष्ट्राद्विप्रवासयेत् ॥ 27 ॥
2.15.m: He who dismisses a servant prematurely shall be fined the same amount. / A man who, having made an agreement in truth with a village, district, or guild, / breaks it out of greed, one should exile from the realm.

2.15.s:
krītvā vikrīya vā kiñcidyasyehānuśayo bhavet ..
sontardaśāhāttatsāmyāddadyāścaivādadīta ca .. 28 ..
2.15.d:
क्रीत्वा विक्रीय वा किञ्चिद्यस्येहानुशयो भवेत् ॥
सोन्तर्दशाहात्तत्साम्याद्दद्याश्चैवाददीत च ॥ 28 ॥
2.15.m: If anyone here has remorse after buying or selling anything, / he may return it and take it back within ten days, according to its equal value.

2.15.s:
pareṇa tu daśāhasya na dadyānnaiva dāpayet ..
ādadadvidadaccaiva rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ .. 29 ..
2.15.d:
परेण तु दशाहस्य न दद्यान्नैव दापयेत् ॥
आददद्विददच्चैव राज्ञा दण्ड्यः शतानि षट् ॥ 29 ॥
2.15.m: Beyond ten days he shall not give it back, nor cause it to be given; / taking it or giving it away, he shall be fined six hundred [paṇas] by the king.

2.15.s:
yastu doṣavatīṃ kanyāṃ tvanākhyāya prayacchati ..
tasya kuryānnṛpo daṇḍaṃ svayaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiṃ paṇān .. 2.72.30 ..
2.15.d:
यस्तु दोषवतीं कन्यां त्वनाख्याय प्रयच्छति ॥
तस्य कुर्यान्नृपो दण्डं स्वयं षण्णवतिं पणान् ॥ 2.72.30 ॥
2.15.m: He who gives away a girl with a defect without disclosing it, / on him the king himself shall impose a fine of ninety-six paṇas.

2.15.s:
akanyeti tu yaḥ kanyāṃ brūyāddveṣeṇa mānavaḥ ..
sa śataṃ prāpnuyāddaṇḍaṃ kanyādoṣamadarśayan .. 31 ..
2.15.d:
अकन्येति तु यः कन्यां ब्रूयाद्द्वेषेण मानवः ॥
स शतं प्राप्नुयाद्दण्डं कन्यादोषमदर्शयन् ॥ 31 ॥
2.15.m: A man who out of malice calls a girl 'no maiden,' / shall incur a fine of one hundred [paṇas] if he does not demonstrate the girl's defect.

2.15.s:
yastvanyāṃ darśayitvānyāṃ voḍhuḥ kanyāṃ prayacchati ..
uttamaṃ tasya kurvīta rājā daṇḍaṃ tu sāhasam .. 32 ..
2.15.d:
यस्त्वन्यां दर्शयित्वान्यां वोढुः कन्यां प्रयच्छति ॥
उत्तमं तस्य कुर्वीत राजा दण्डं तु साहसम् ॥ 32 ॥
2.15.m: He who shows one girl and gives another to the groom, / on him the king shall impose the highest level of punishment.

2.15.s:
varo doṣānabhikhyāpya yaḥ kanyāṃ varayediha ..
dattāpyadattā sā tasya rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatadvayam .. 33 ..
2.15.d:
वरो दोषानभिख्याप्य यः कन्यां वरयेदिह ॥
दत्ताप्यदत्ता सा तस्य राज्ञा दण्ड्यः शतद्वयम् ॥ 33 ॥
2.15.m: A groom who courts a maiden here without disclosing his defects, / though given, she is not given to him, and he must be fined two hundred by the king.

2.15.s:
pradāya kanyāṃ yo'nyasmai punastāṃ samprayacchati ..
daṇḍaḥ kāryo narendreṇa tasyāpyuttamasāhasaḥ .. 34 ..
2.15.d:
प्रदाय कन्यां योऽन्यस्मै पुनस्तां सम्प्रयच्छति ॥
दण्डः कार्यो नरेन्द्रेण तस्याप्युत्तमसाहसः ॥ 34 ॥
2.15.m: He who, having betrothed a maiden to one, gives her to another, / on him also the ruler of men must impose the highest level of punishment.

2.15.s:
satyaṃkāreṇa vācā ca yuktaṃ paryāsamaṃ śayam ..
lubdho'nyatra tu vikretā ṣaṭśataṃ daṇḍamarhati .. 35 ..
2.15.d:
सत्यंकारेण वाचा च युक्तं पर्यासमं शयम् ॥
लुब्धोऽन्यत्र तु विक्रेता षट्शतं दण्डमर्हति ॥ 35 ॥
2.15.m: When a deal is bound by earnest money and verbal agreement, / a greedy seller who [sells] elsewhere deserves a fine of six hundred.

2.15.s:
vahecchulkaṃ tu vikretā satyaṃkāraṃ tu saṃtyajet ..
dviguṇaṃ daṇḍayedenamiti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ .. 36 ..
2.15.d:
वहेच्छुल्कं तु विक्रेता सत्यंकारं तु संत्यजेत् ॥
द्विगुणं दण्डयेदेनमिति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः ॥ 36 ॥
2.15.m: The seller shall bear the toll and forfeit the earnest money; / one should fine him double: this is the established rule of dharma.

2.15.s:
mūlyaikadeśaṃ dattvā tu yadi kretā dhanaṃ tyajet ..
daṇḍayaḥ sa madhyamaṃ daṇḍaṃ tasya daṇḍasya mokṣaṇāt .. 37 ..
2.15.d:
मूल्यैकदेशं दत्त्वा तु यदि क्रेता धनं त्यजेत् ॥
दण्डयः स मध्यमं दण्डं तस्य दण्डस्य मोक्षणात् ॥ 37 ॥
2.15.m: If a buyer, having paid a portion of the price, abandons the property, / he should be fined the middle punishment, upon releasing that [property from] attachment.

2.15.s:
druhyādbhṛtastu yaḥ pālaṃ gṛhītvā bhaktavetanam ..
sa tu daṇḍyaḥ śataṃ rājñā suvarṇaṃ svāmyarakṣiṇā .. .. 38 ..
2.15.d:
द्रुह्याद्भृतस्तु यः पालं गृहीत्वा भक्तवेतनम् ॥
स तु दण्ड्यः शतं राज्ञा सुवर्णं स्वाम्यरक्षिणा ॥ ॥ 38 ॥
2.15.m: A herdsman who, having received food and wages, harms [the cattle], / must be fined a hundred suvarṇas by the king for failing to protect the owner's property.

2.15.s:
daṇḍaṃ dattvā na virametsvāmibhiḥ kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ ..
baddhaḥ kṛtvāyasaiḥ pāśaistasya karmakaro bhavet .. 39 ..
2.15.d:
दण्डं दत्त्वा न विरमेत्स्वामिभिः कृतलक्षणः ॥
बद्धः कृत्वायसैः पाशैस्तस्य कर्मकरो भवेत् ॥ 39 ॥
2.15.m: If having paid the fine he does not desist, branded by his masters, / bound with iron fetters, he shall become his laborer.

2.15.s:
dhanuścatuḥparīmāṇaṃ grāmasya tu samantataḥ ..
dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vāpi nagarasya tu kalpayet ..2.72.40 ..
2.15.d:
धनुश्चतुःपरीमाणं ग्रामस्य तु समन्ततः ॥
द्विगुणं त्रिगुणं वापि नगरस्य तु कल्पयेत् ॥2.72.40 ॥
2.15.m: A boundary of four bow-lengths all around a village, / and double or triple that for a city, one should arrange.

2.15.s:
vṛtiṃ tatra prakurvīta yāmuṣṭro nāvalokayet ..
chidraṃ nivārayetsarvaṃ śvasūkaramukhānugam .. 41 ..
2.15.d:
वृतिं तत्र प्रकुर्वीत यामुष्ट्रो नावलोकयेत् ॥
छिद्रं निवारयेत्सर्वं श्वसूकरमुखानुगम् ॥ 41 ॥
2.15.m: There one should erect a fence over which a camel cannot look, / and stop every gap accessible to the snouts of dogs and pigs.

2.15.s:
tatrāparadhṛtaṃ dhānyaṃ mahiṣyaḥ paśavo yadi ..
na tatra kārayeddaṇḍaṃ nṛpatiḥ paśurakṣiṇām ..42 ..
2.15.d:
तत्रापरधृतं धान्यं महिष्यः पशवो यदि ॥
न तत्र कारयेद्दण्डं नृपतिः पशुरक्षिणाम् ॥42 ॥
2.15.m: If grain there is eaten by buffaloes or livestock [that broke in], / the king shall not impose a fine on the herdsmen.

2.15.s:
anirdaśāhāṃ gāṃ sūtāṃ vṛṣāndevapaśūṃstathā ..
sapālānvā vipālānvā na daṇḍyānmanurabravīt .. 43 ..
2.15.d:
अनिर्दशाहां गां सूतां वृषान्देवपशूंस्तथा ॥
सपालान्वा विपालान्वा न दण्ड्यान्मनुरब्रवीत् ॥ 43 ॥
2.15.m: A cow that has calved within ten days, bulls, and temple cattle, / whether with a keeper or without, Manu stated are not to be fined.

2.15.s: ato'nyathā vinaṣṭasya daśāṃśaṃ daṇḍamarhati .. 44 ..
2.15.d: अतोऽन्यथा विनष्टस्य दशांशं दण्डमर्हति ॥ 44 ॥
2.15.m: Otherwise, one deserves a fine of a tenth part of what is destroyed.

2.15.s:
pālastvapālakī svāmī vināśe kṣattriyasya tu ..
bhakṣayitvopaviṣṭāsu dviguṇaṃ daṇḍamarhati .. 45 ..
2.15.d:
पालस्त्वपालकी स्वामी विनाशे क्षत्त्रियस्य तु ॥
भक्षयित्वोपविष्टासु द्विगुणं दण्डमर्हति ॥ 45 ॥
2.15.m: The keeper or, if without a keeper, the owner, when an owner's crop is destroyed— / if [the cattle] sat down after grazing, he deserves double the fine.

2.15.s:
vairāddaśaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ vināśātkṣattriyasya tu ..
gṛhaṃ taḍāgamārāmaṃ kṣetraṃ buddhvā hyapāharan ..
śatāni pañca daṇḍyaḥ syādajñānāddviśato damaḥ .. 46 ..
2.15.d:
वैराद्दशगुणं दण्डं विनाशात्क्षत्त्रियस्य तु ॥
गृहं तडागमारामं क्षेत्रं बुद्ध्वा ह्यपाहरन् ॥
शतानि पञ्च दण्ड्यः स्यादज्ञानाद्द्विशतो दमः ॥ 46 ॥
2.15.m: For destruction through malice, ten times the fine [is prescribed]. / Knowingly seizing a house, a pond, a garden, or a field, / one shall be fined five hundred; out of ignorance, the fine is two hundred.

2.15.s:
sīmābandhanakāle tu sīmābandhanakāriṇām ..
teṣāṃ saṃjñāṃ dadhānastu jihvācchedanamāpnuyāt ..47 ..
2.15.d:
सीमाबन्धनकाले तु सीमाबन्धनकारिणाम् ॥
तेषां संज्ञां दधानस्तु जिह्वाच्छेदनमाप्नुयात् ॥47 ॥
2.15.m: At the time of marking the boundary, he who assigns marks / [falsely] to those who mark boundaries, shall suffer the cutting off of his tongue.

2.15.s:
arthenāpi ca yo vidyātsaṃvidaṃ vāpi gacchati ..
uttamaṃ sāhasaṃ daṇḍya iti svāyaṃbhuvo 'bravīt .. 48 ..
2.15.d:
अर्थेनापि च यो विद्यात्संविदं वापि गच्छति ॥
उत्तमं साहसं दण्ड्य इति स्वायंभुवो ऽब्रवीत् ॥ 48 ॥
2.15.m: He who knows [the boundary] for money, or enters into a conspiracy, / is to be fined the highest level of punishment; thus the Self-existent spoke.

2.15.s: sthāpitāṃ cāpi maryādāṃ ye bhindyuḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ .. 49 ..
2.15.d: स्थापितां चापि मर्यादां ये भिन्द्युः पापकारिणः ॥ 49 ॥
2.15.m: And the evil-doers who break an established boundary—

2.15.s:
sarve pṛthakpṛthagdaṇḍyā rājñā prathamasāhasam ..
śataṃ brāhmaṇamākruśya kṣattriyo daṇḍamarhati .. 2.72.50 ..
2.15.d:
सर्वे पृथक्पृथग्दण्ड्या राज्ञा प्रथमसाहसम् ॥
शतं ब्राह्मणमाक्रुश्य क्षत्त्रियो दण्डमर्हति ॥ 2.72.50 ॥
2.15.m: all of them individually are to be fined the first level of punishment by the king. / A kṣatriya who reviles a brahmin deserves a fine of one hundred;

2.15.s:
vaiśyaśca dviśataṃ rāma śūdraśca vadhamarhati ..
pañcāśadbrāhmaṇo daṇḍyaḥ kṣattriyasyāpi śāsane .. 51 ..
2.15.d:
वैश्यश्च द्विशतं राम शूद्रश्च वधमर्हति ॥
पञ्चाशद्ब्राह्मणो दण्ड्यः क्षत्त्रियस्यापि शासने ॥ 51 ॥
2.15.m: and a vaiśya two hundred, O Rāma, and a śūdra deserves corporal punishment. / A brahmin is to be fined fifty for defaming a kṣatriya;

2.15.s:
vaiśye cāpyardhapañcāśacchūdro dvādaśako'dhamaḥ ..
kṣattriyasyāpnuyādvaiśyaḥ sāhasaṃ pūrvameva tu .. 52 ..
2.15.d:
वैश्ये चाप्यर्धपञ्चाशच्छूद्रो द्वादशकोऽधमः ॥
क्षत्त्रियस्याप्नुयाद्वैश्यः साहसं पूर्वमेव तु ॥ 52 ॥
2.15.m: and twenty-five for a vaiśya; for a vile śūdra, twelve. / A vaiśya reviling a kṣatriya should incur the first level of punishment;

2.15.s:
śūdraḥ kṣatriyamātrasya jihvācchedanamāpnuyāt ..
pañcāśatkṣatriyo daṇḍyastathā vaiśyābhiśāsane .. 53 ..
2.15.d:
शूद्रः क्षत्रियमात्रस्य जिह्वाच्छेदनमाप्नुयात् ॥
पञ्चाशत्क्षत्रियो दण्ड्यस्तथा वैश्याभिशासने ॥ 53 ॥
2.15.m: a śūdra [reviling] a mere kṣatriya should suffer the cutting of his tongue. / A kṣatriya should be fined fifty for defaming a vaiśya,

2.15.s:
śūdre caivārdhapañcāśattathā dharmo na hīyate ..
vaiśyasyākrośane daṇḍyaḥ śūdraścottama sāhasam .. 54 ..
2.15.d:
शूद्रे चैवार्धपञ्चाशत्तथा धर्मो न हीयते ॥
वैश्यस्याक्रोशने दण्ड्यः शूद्रश्चोत्तम साहसम् ॥ 54 ॥
2.15.m: and twenty-five for a śūdra; thus dharma is not diminished. / For reviling a vaiśya, a śūdra must be fined the highest level of punishment;

2.15.s:
śūdrākrośe tathā vaiśyaḥ śatārdhaṃ daṇḍamarhati ..
savarṇākrośane daṇḍastathā dvādaśikaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 55..
2.15.d:
शूद्राक्रोशे तथा वैश्यः शतार्धं दण्डमर्हति ॥
सवर्णाक्रोशने दण्डस्तथा द्वादशिकः स्मृतः ॥ 55॥
2.15.m: and for reviling a śūdra, a vaiśya deserves a fine of fifty. / For reviling an equal in caste, a fine of twelve is prescribed.

2.15.s:
vādeṣu vacanīyeṣu tadeva dviguṇaṃ bhaveta ..
ekajātirdvijātiṃ tu vācā dāruṇayā kṣipan ..
jihvāyāḥ prāpnuyācchedaṃ jaghanyaprabhavo hi saḥ .. 56 ..
2.15.d:
वादेषु वचनीयेषु तदेव द्विगुणं भवेत ॥
एकजातिर्द्विजातिं तु वाचा दारुणया क्षिपन् ॥
जिह्वायाः प्राप्नुयाच्छेदं जघन्यप्रभवो हि सः ॥ 56 ॥
2.15.m:
In debates concerning censurable insults, it shall be double that.
When a once-born man assails a twice-born man with harsh speech,
he should suffer the cutting of his tongue, for he has sprung from the lowest origin.

2.15.s:
nāmajātigrahaṃ teṣāmabhidroheṇa kurvataḥ ..
nikhanyo'yomayaḥ śaṅkurjvalannāsye daśāṅgulaḥ .. 57 ..
2.15.d:
नामजातिग्रहं तेषामभिद्रोहेण कुर्वतः ॥
निखन्योऽयोमयः शङ्कुर्ज्वलन्नास्ये दशाङ्गुलः ॥ 57 ॥
2.15.m:
If he mentions their names and castes with malice,
a burning iron stake, ten fingers long, is to be driven into his mouth.

2.15.s:
dharmopadeśadharmeṇa dvijānāmasya kurvataḥ ..
taptamāsiñcayettailaṃ vaktre śrotre ca pārthivaḥ ..58..
2.15.d:
धर्मोपदेशधर्मेण द्विजानामस्य कुर्वतः ॥
तप्तमासिञ्चयेत्तैलं वक्त्रे श्रोत्रे च पार्थिवः ॥58॥
2.15.m:
If through [arrogance of] virtue he offers instruction in dharma to twice-born men,
the king should pour boiling oil into his mouth and ears.

2.15.s:
śṛtaṃ deśaṃ ca jātiṃ ca karma śārīrameva ca ..
vitathaṃ tu bruvandaṇḍyo rājñā dviguṇasāhasam .. 59 ..
2.15.d:
शृतं देशं च जातिं च कर्म शारीरमेव च ॥
वितथं तु ब्रुवन्दण्ड्यो राज्ञा द्विगुणसाहसम् ॥ 59 ॥
2.15.m:
One who speaks falsely concerning someone’s learning, country, caste,
and bodily action is to be fined double the [first] amercement by the king.

2.15.s:
yastu pātakasaṃyuktaiḥ kṣipedvarṇāntarau viśaḥ ..
uttamaṃ sāhasaṃ tasmindaṇḍaḥ pātyo yathākramam .. 2.72.60 ..
2.15.d:
यस्तु पातकसंयुक्तैः क्षिपेद्वर्णान्तरौ विशः ॥
उत्तमं साहसं तस्मिन्दण्डः पात्यो यथाक्रमम् ॥ 2.72.60 ॥
2.15.m:
If one insults a vaiśya of another caste with accusations of major sins,
the highest amercement must be imposed upon him in due order.

2.15.s: rājño niveśya niyamaṃ prathamaṃ yānti ye mithaḥ .. 61 ..
2.15.d: राज्ञो निवेश्य नियमं प्रथमं यान्ति ये मिथः ॥ 61 ॥
2.15.m: Those who, having established a covenant before the king, at first violate it mutually,

2.15.s:
sarve dviguṇadaṇḍyāste vipralambhānnṛpasya tu ..
prītyā mayāsyābhihitaṃ pramādenāthavā vadet ..
bhūyo na caivaṃ vakṣyāmi sa tu daṇḍārdhabhāgbhavet .. 62 ..
2.15.d:
सर्वे द्विगुणदण्ड्यास्ते विप्रलम्भान्नृपस्य तु ॥
प्रीत्या मयास्याभिहितं प्रमादेनाथवा वदेत् ॥
भूयो न चैवं वक्ष्यामि स तु दण्डार्धभाग्भवेत् ॥ 62 ॥

2.15.s:
kāṇaṃ vāpyathavā khañjamandhaṃ vāpi tathāvidham ..
tathyenāpi bruvandāpyo daṇḍaḥ kārṣāpaṇāvaram .. 63 ..
2.15.d:
काणं वाप्यथवा खञ्जमन्धं वापि तथाविधम् ॥
तथ्येनापि ब्रुवन्दाप्यो दण्डः कार्षापणावरम् ॥ 63 ॥
2.15.m:
One who calls [another] one-eyed, or lame, or blind, or similarly afflicted,
even when speaking the truth, must be made to pay a fine of at least a kārṣāpaṇa.

2.15.s:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaraṃ śvaśuraṃ gurum ..
ākṣārayacchataṃ daṇḍyaḥ panthānaṃ cādadadguroḥ ..64 ..
2.15.d:
मातरं पितरं ज्येष्ठं भ्रातरं श्वशुरं गुरुम् ॥
आक्षारयच्छतं दण्ड्यः पन्थानं चाददद्गुरोः ॥64 ॥
2.15.m:
One who reviles mother, father, eldest brother, father-in-law, or guru
is to be fined one hundred [paṇas], and likewise for not yielding the path to a guru.

2.15.s:
guruvarjyaṃ tu mārgārhe yo mārgaṃ na prayacchati ..
sa rājñā kṛṣṇalaṃ daṇḍyastasya pāpasya śāntaye ..65..
2.15.d:
गुरुवर्ज्यं तु मार्गार्हे यो मार्गं न प्रयच्छति ॥
स राज्ञा कृष्णलं दण्ड्यस्तस्य पापस्य शान्तये ॥65॥
2.15.m:
Excepting a guru, whoever fails to give way to one worthy of the road
is to be fined a kṛṣṇala by the king, for the expiation of that sin.

2.15.s:
ekajātirdvijātintu yenāṅgenāparādhnuyāt ..
tadeva cchedayettasya kṣipramevāvicārayan ..66..
2.15.d:
एकजातिर्द्विजातिन्तु येनाङ्गेनापराध्नुयात् ॥
तदेव च्छेदयेत्तस्य क्षिप्रमेवाविचारयन् ॥66॥
2.15.m:
With whatever limb a once-born man offends against a twice-born man,
that very [limb] of his he should cut off, swiftly and without hesitation.

2.15.s:
avaniṣṭhīvato darpāddvāvoṣṭhau chedayennṛpaḥ ..
avasecayato meḍhramavaśabdayato gudam .. 67 ..
2.15.d:
अवनिष्ठीवतो दर्पाद्द्वावोष्ठौ छेदयेन्नृपः ॥
अवसेचयतो मेढ्रमवशब्दयतो गुदम् ॥ 67 ॥
2.15.m:
If he spits upon him out of arrogance, the king should cut off both his lips;
if he urinates upon him, his penis; if he farts upon him, his anus.

2.15.s: mahāsanamabhiprepsurutkṛṣṭasyāvakṛṣṭajaḥ .. 68 ..
2.15.d: महासनमभिप्रेप्सुरुत्कृष्टस्यावकृष्टजः ॥ 68 ॥
2.15.m: A low-born man desiring a high seat of a superior,

2.15.s:
kṛtāṅkaḥ sa vinirvāsyo hyaṅgaṃ vāsya vikartayet ..
keśeṣu gṛhṇato hastau chedayedavicārayan ..
pādayordaṇḍikāyāṃ tu grīvāyāṃ vṛṣaṇeṣu vā .. 69 ..
2.15.d:
कृताङ्कः स विनिर्वास्यो ह्यङ्गं वास्य विकर्तयेत् ॥
केशेषु गृह्णतो हस्तौ छेदयेदविचारयन् ॥
पादयोर्दण्डिकायां तु ग्रीवायां वृषणेषु वा ॥ 69 ॥
2.15.m:
branded, should be banished, or [the king] should mutilate his limb.
If he seizes [him] by the hair, both his hands should be cut off without hesitation,
and likewise if [he seizes him] by the two feet, the beard, the neck, or the testicles.

2.15.s: tvagbhedakaḥ śataṃ daṇḍyo lohitasya ca darśakaḥ .. 2.72.70 ..
2.15.d: त्वग्भेदकः शतं दण्ड्यो लोहितस्य च दर्शकः ॥ 2.72.70 ॥
2.15.m: One who tears the skin and causes blood to appear is to be fined one hundred [paṇas].

2.15.s:
asthibhettā ca ṣaṇṇiṣkānpramāpyaśca pramāpakaḥ ..
aṅgabhaṅgakarasyāṃgaṃ tadevāpaharennṛpaḥ .. 71 ..
2.15.d:
अस्थिभेत्ता च षण्णिष्कान्प्रमाप्यश्च प्रमापकः ॥
अङ्गभङ्गकरस्यांगं तदेवापहरेन्नृपः ॥ 71 ॥
2.15.m:
And one who breaks a bone [shall be fined] six niṣkas; and a killer must be put to death.
From one who breaks a limb, the king should cut off that very limb.

2.15.s:
daṇḍapāruṣyakṛddadyātsamutthānavyayaṃ tathā ..
ardhapādakarāḥ kāryā gogajāśvoṣṭraghātakāḥ .. 72 ..
2.15.d:
दण्डपारुष्यकृद्दद्यात्समुत्थानव्ययं तथा ॥
अर्धपादकराः कार्या गोगजाश्वोष्ट्रघातकाः ॥ 72 ॥
2.15.m:
One who inflicts physical injury must also pay the expenses of medical recovery.
Slayers of cows, elephants, horses, and camels should be made to lose half a foot.

2.15.s:
paśukṣudramṛgāṇāṃ ca hiṃsāyāṃ dviguṇo damaḥ ..
pañcāśattu bhaveddaṇḍastathaiva mṛgapakṣiṣu .. 73 ..
2.15.d:
पशुक्षुद्रमृगाणां च हिंसायां द्विगुणो दमः ॥
पञ्चाशत्तु भवेद्दण्डस्तथैव मृगपक्षिषु ॥ 73 ॥
2.15.m:
For violence toward domestic and small wild animals, the fine is double.
And in the case of deer and birds, the fine shall be fifty [paṇas].

2.15.s:
kṛmikīṭeṣu daṇḍaḥ syādrajatasya tu māṣakam ..
tasyānurūpaṃ mūlyaṃ ca pradadyātsvāmine tathā ..74..
2.15.d:
कृमिकीटेषु दण्डः स्याद्रजतस्य तु माषकम् ॥
तस्यानुरूपं मूल्यं च प्रदद्यात्स्वामिने तथा ॥74॥
2.15.m:
For worms and insects, the fine should be a silver māṣaka;
and likewise he must pay a fitting price to the owner.

2.15.s:
sasvāmikānāṃ marake śeṣāṇāṃ daṇḍameva tu ..
vṛkṣaṃ tu saphalaṃ chittvā suvarṇaṃ daṇḍamarhati .. 75 ..
2.15.d:
सस्वामिकानां मरके शेषाणां दण्डमेव तु ॥
वृक्षं तु सफलं छित्त्वा सुवर्णं दण्डमर्हति ॥ 75 ॥
2.15.m:
In the case of the death of [creatures] that have owners, [he pays compensation;] for the rest, only the fine.
Having cut down a fruit-bearing tree, he deserves a fine of a suvarṇa.

2.15.s:
dviguṇaṃ daṇḍayeccaitye pathi sīmni jalāśaye ..
chedanādaphalasyāpi madhyamaḥ sāhasaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 76 ..
2.15.d:
द्विगुणं दण्डयेच्चैत्ये पथि सीम्नि जलाशये ॥
छेदनादफलस्यापि मध्यमः साहसः स्मृतः ॥ 76 ॥
2.15.m:
He should fine [him] double for [a tree] at a sacred shrine, on a path, at a boundary, or at a reservoir of water.
For cutting even a fruit-less tree, the medium amercement is prescribed.

2.15.s:
gulmavallīlatānāṃ tu suvarṇasya ca māṣakam ..
vṛthā chede tṛṇasyāpi daṇḍaḥ kārṣāpaṇaṃ bhavet .. 77 ..
2.15.d:
गुल्मवल्लीलतानां तु सुवर्णस्य च माषकम् ॥
वृथा छेदे तृणस्यापि दण्डः कार्षापणं भवेत् ॥ 77 ॥
2.15.m:
For bushes, creepers, and vines, [the fine is] a māṣaka of gold.
For the wanton cutting of even grass, the fine shall be a kārṣāpaṇa.

2.15.s:
tribhāgaṃ kṛṣṇalāndaṇḍayaḥ prāṇinastāḍane tathā ..
deśakālānurūpeṇa mūlyaṃ rāma! drumādiṣu .. 78 ..
2.15.d:
त्रिभागं कृष्णलान्दण्डयः प्राणिनस्ताडने तथा ॥
देशकालानुरूपेण मूल्यं राम! द्रुमादिषु ॥ 78 ॥
2.15.m:
One should fine [him] one-third of a kṛṣṇala for striking a living being;
and in the case of trees and the like, O Rāma, a price according to region and season,

2.15.s:
tatsvāmini tathā dadyāddaṇḍamuktaṃ ca pārthive ..
yatrātivartate yugyaṃ vaiguṇyādrajakasya tu ..79 ..
2.15.d:
तत्स्वामिनि तथा दद्याद्दण्डमुक्तं च पार्थिवे ॥
यत्रातिवर्तते युग्यं वैगुण्याद्रजकस्य तु ॥79 ॥
2.15.m:
he must likewise pay to its owner, and the prescribed fine to the king.
Where a carriage veers out of control through the fault of the driver,

2.15.s:
tatra svāmī bhaveddaṇḍyo nāptaścedvyājako bhavet ..
prāṇakaśca bhavedāptaḥ prājako daṇḍamarhati .. 2.72.80..
2.15.d:
तत्र स्वामी भवेद्दण्ड्यो नाप्तश्चेद्व्याजको भवेत् ॥
प्राणकश्च भवेदाप्तः प्राजको दण्डमर्हति ॥ 2.72.80॥
2.15.m:
there the owner shall be fined, if the driver is not qualified;
and if the driver is qualified, the driver deserves the fine.

2.15.s: nāsti daṇḍaṃ ca tasyāpi tathā trāhīti jalpataḥ .. 81 ..
2.15.d: नास्ति दण्डं च तस्यापि तथा त्राहीति जल्पतः ॥ 81 ॥
2.15.m: There is no fine even for him if he cries out: “Beware!”

2.15.s:
dravyāṇi yo haredyasya jānato'jānato'pi vā ..
sa tasyotpādayettuṣṭiṃ rājño dadyāttato damam .. 82 ..
2.15.d:
द्रव्याणि यो हरेद्यस्य जानतोऽजानतोऽपि वा ॥
स तस्योत्पादयेत्तुष्टिं राज्ञो दद्यात्ततो दमम् ॥ 82 ॥
2.15.m:
Whoever takes someone’s goods, whether knowingly or unknowingly,
must satisfy him and then pay a fine to the king.

2.15.s:
yastu rajjuṃ ghaṭaṃ kūpāddharedbhindyācca tāṃ prapām ..
sa daṇḍaṃ prāpnuyānmāṣaṃ tacca saṃpratipādayet .. 83 ..
2.15.d:
यस्तु रज्जुं घटं कूपाद्धरेद्भिन्द्याच्च तां प्रपाम् ॥
स दण्डं प्राप्नुयान्माषं तच्च संप्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 83 ॥
2.15.m:
Whoever takes a rope or a pot from a well, or destroys that cistern of water,
shall receive a fine of a māṣa, and must restore that [item].

2.15.s:
dhānyaṃ daśabhyaḥ kumbhebhyo harato'bhyadhikaṃ budhaḥ ..
śeṣe'pyekādaśaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ tasya prakalpayet ..84..
2.15.d:
धान्यं दशभ्यः कुम्भेभ्यो हरतोऽभ्यधिकं बुधः ॥
शेषेऽप्येकादशगुणं दण्डं तस्य प्रकल्पयेत् ॥84॥
2.15.m:
From one who steals more than ten kumbhas of grain, the wise king
[shall inflict capital punishment;] for the rest, he should determine his fine at eleven times [the value].

2.15.s:
suvarṇarajatādīnāṃ cottamānāṃ ca vāsasām ..
puruṣāṇāṃ kulīnānāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
mukhyānāṃ caiva ratnānāṃ haraṇe vadhamarhati..85..
2.15.d:
सुवर्णरजतादीनां चोत्तमानां च वाससाम् ॥
पुरुषाणां कुलीनानां नारीणां च विशेषतः ॥
मुख्यानां चैव रत्नानां हरणे वधमर्हति॥85॥
2.15.m:
For the theft of gold, silver, and other [metals], and of the finest garments,
especially of noble men and women,
and of chief jewels, he deserves death.

2.15.s:
mahāpaśūnāṃ haraṇe vastrāṇāmauṣadhasya ca ..
kālamāsādya kāryaṃ ca rājā daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet .. 86 ..
2.15.d:
महापशूनां हरणे वस्त्राणामौषधस्य च ॥
कालमासाद्य कार्यं च राजा दण्डं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 86 ॥
2.15.m:
For the theft of large animals, cloths, and medicines,
having considered the time and the deed, the king should determine the punishment.

2.15.s:
goṣu brāhmaṇasaṃsthāsu sthūlakāryāvibhedane ..
aśvāpahārakaścaiva sadyaḥ kāryordhapādikaḥ .. 87 ..
2.15.d:
गोषु ब्राह्मणसंस्थासु स्थूलकार्याविभेदने ॥
अश्वापहारकश्चैव सद्यः कार्योर्धपादिकः ॥ 87 ॥
2.15.m:
In the case of cattle belonging to brahmins, or piercing through a large barrier,
and for a thief of horses, one should immediately cut off half a foot.

2.15.s:
sūtrakārpāsakilvānāṃ gomayasya guḍasya ca ..
dadhnaḥ kṣīrasya takrasya pānīyasya phalasya ca .. 88. ..
veṇuvaidalabhāṇḍānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
mṛṇmayānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mṛdo bhasmana eva ca ..89..
2.15.d:
सूत्रकार्पासकिल्वानां गोमयस्य गुडस्य च ॥
दध्नः क्षीरस्य तक्रस्य पानीयस्य फलस्य च ॥ 88॥।
वेणुवैदलभाण्डानां लवणानां तथैव च ॥
मृण्मयानां च सर्वेषां मृदो भस्मन एव च ॥89॥

2.15.s:
madyānāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva tailasya ca ghṛtasya ca ..
māṃsasya madhunaścaiva yaccānyatpaśusambhavam..2.72.90..
2.15.d:
मद्यानां पक्षिणां चैव तैलस्य च घृतस्य च ॥
मांसस्य मधुनश्चैव यच्चान्यत्पशुसम्भवम्॥2.72.90॥
2.15.m:
for liquors, and birds, for oil, and for clarified butter;
for meat, and honey, and whatever else originates from an animal;

2.15.s:
anyeṣāmevamādīnāṃ matsyānāmodanasya ca ..
pakvānnānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tanmūlyāddviguṇo damaḥ .. 91 ..
2.15.d:
अन्येषामेवमादीनां मत्स्यानामोदनस्य च ॥
पक्वान्नानां च सर्वेषां तन्मूल्याद्द्विगुणो दमः ॥ 91 ॥
2.15.m:
for other such [goods], and fish, and cooked rice,
and all cooked foods, the fine is double their value.

2.15.s:
puṣpeṣu harite dhānye gulmavallīlatāsu ca ...
alpeṣu paripūrṇeṣu daṇḍaḥ syātpañcamāṣakaḥ .. 92 ..
2.15.d:
पुष्पेषु हरिते धान्ये गुल्मवल्लीलतासु च ॥।
अल्पेषु परिपूर्णेषु दण्डः स्यात्पञ्चमाषकः ॥ 92 ॥
2.15.m:
For flowers, green corn, and bushes, creepers, and vines,
whether little or in abundance, the fine should be five māṣakas.

2.15.s:
paripūrṇeṣu dhānyeṣu śākamūlaphaleṣu ca ..
niranvaye śataṃ daṇḍyaḥ sānvaye ca śataṃ damaḥ .. 93 ..
2.15.d:
परिपूर्णेषु धान्येषु शाकमूलफलेषु च ॥
निरन्वये शतं दण्ड्यः सान्वये च शतं दमः ॥ 93 ॥
2.15.m:
For ripe grains, vegetables, roots, and fruits,
one having no kinship is to be fined one hundred; and for one having kinship, the fine is one hundred.

2.15.s:
yenayena yathāṅgena steno nṛṣu viceṣṭate ..
tattadeva haredasya pratyādeśāya pārthivaḥ .. 94 ..
2.15.d:
येनयेन यथाङ्गेन स्तेनो नृषु विचेष्टते ॥
तत्तदेव हरेदस्य प्रत्यादेशाय पार्थिवः ॥ 94 ॥
2.15.m:
With whatever limb a thief operates against men,
that very limb the king should take from him, as a deterrent.

2.15.s:
dvijo'dhvagaḥ kṣīṇavṛttirdvāvikṣu dve ca mūlake ..
trapusorvārukau dvaudvau tāvanmānaṃ phaleṣu ca .. 95 ..
2.15.d:
द्विजोऽध्वगः क्षीणवृत्तिर्द्वाविक्षु द्वे च मूलके ॥
त्रपुसोर्वारुकौ द्वौद्वौ तावन्मानं फलेषु च ॥ 95 ॥
2.15.m:
A twice-born traveler whose livelihood is exhausted [may take] two sugarcanes and two radishes,
two cucumbers and two melons, and a like measure of fruits;

2.15.s:
tathā ca sarvadhānyānāṃ muṣṭigrāheṇa bhārgava ..
śākaṃ śākapramāṇena gṛhyamāṇo na duṣyati .. 96 ..
2.15.d:
तथा च सर्वधान्यानां मुष्टिग्राहेण भार्गव ॥
शाकं शाकप्रमाणेन गृह्यमाणो न दुष्यति ॥ 96 ॥
2.15.m:
and likewise a handful of all grains, O descendant of Bhṛgu;
taking vegetables in the measure of [a meal of] greens, he incurs no sin.

2.15.s:
vānaspatyaṃ mūlaphalaṃ dārvagnyarthaṃ tathaiva ca ..
tṛṇaṃ ca gobhyo dānārthamasteyaṃ manurabravīt .. 97 ..
2.15.d:
वानस्पत्यं मूलफलं दार्वग्न्यर्थं तथैव च ॥
तृणं च गोभ्यो दानार्थमस्तेयं मनुरब्रवीत् ॥ 97 ॥
2.15.m:
Roots and fruits from forest trees, firewood for the purpose of the [sacred] fire,
and grass for giving to cows, Manu has declared to be non-theft.

2.15.s:
adevavāṭajaṃ puṣpaṃ devatārthaṃ tathaiva ca ..
ādadānaḥ parakṣetrānna daṇḍaṃ dātumarhati .. 98 ..
2.15.d:
अदेववाटजं पुष्पं देवतार्थं तथैव च ॥
आददानः परक्षेत्रान्न दण्डं दातुमर्हति ॥ 98 ॥
2.15.m:
Taking flowers not grown in a garden, for the purpose of a deity,
from another's field, he does not deserve to pay a fine.

2.15.s:
śṛṅgiṇaṃ nakhinaṃ cāpi daṃṣṭriṇaṃ vā vadhodyatam ..
yo hanyānna sa pāpena lipyate manujaḥ kvacit .. 99 ..
2.15.d:
शृङ्गिणं नखिनं चापि दंष्ट्रिणं वा वधोद्यतम् ॥
यो हन्यान्न स पापेन लिप्यते मनुजः क्वचित् ॥ 99 ॥
2.15.m:
A person who kills a horned beast, or a clawed beast, or a fanged beast
that has approached to kill him, is not tainted by sin anywhere.

2.15.s:
guruṃ vā bālavṛddhau vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā bahuśrutam ..
ātatāyinamāyāntaṃ hanyādevāvicārayan .. 2.72.100 ..
2.15.d:
गुरुं वा बालवृद्धौ वा ब्राह्मणं वा बहुश्रुतम् ॥
आततायिनमायान्तं हन्यादेवाविचारयन् ॥ 2.72.100 ॥
2.15.m: Whether a guru, a child, an old man, or a brahmin deeply learned in scripture, / one should kill an advancing assassin without hesitation.

2.15.s:
nātatāyivadhe doṣaḥ karturbhavati kaścana ..
prakāśaṃ vā'prakāśaṃ vā manyustaṃ manyumarhati .. 101 ..
2.15.d:
नाततायिवधे दोषः कर्तुर्भवति कश्चन ॥
प्रकाशं वाऽप्रकाशं वा मन्युस्तं मन्युमर्हति ॥ 101 ॥
2.15.m: No guilt whatsoever accrues to the killer in the slaying of an assassin; / openly or secretly, fury confronts fury.

2.15.s:
gṛhakṣetrābhihartāraṃ tathā patnyabhigāminam ..
agnidaṃ garadaṃ caiva tathā hastodyatāyudham .. 102 ..
2.15.d:
गृहक्षेत्राभिहर्तारं तथा पत्न्यभिगामिनम् ॥
अग्निदं गरदं चैव तथा हस्तोद्यतायुधम् ॥ 102 ॥
2.15.m: One who seizes house or field, likewise one who violates a wife, / an arsonist, a poisoner, and one with a weapon raised in hand,

2.15.s:
abhicāraṃ ca kurvāṇaṃ rājagāmi ca paiśunam ..
ete hi kathitā loke dharmajñairātatāyinaḥ .. 103 ..
2.15.d:
अभिचारं च कुर्वाणं राजगामि च पैशुनम् ॥
एते हि कथिता लोके धर्मज्ञैराततायिनः ॥ 103 ॥
2.15.m: one practicing sorcery, and one who carries slander to the king— / these indeed are proclaimed in the world by knowers of dharma to be assassins.

2.15.s:
parastriyaṃ na saṃbhāṣettīrthe'raṇye gṛhe'pi vā ..
nadīnāṃ caiva saṃbhede saṃgrahaṇamavāpnuyāt .. 104 ..
2.15.d:
परस्त्रियं न संभाषेत्तीर्थेऽरण्ये गृहेऽपि वा ॥
नदीनां चैव संभेदे संग्रहणमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 104 ॥
2.15.m: One should not converse with another's wife at a pilgrimage site, in a forest, or in a house, / or at the confluence of rivers; [otherwise] one incurs [the charge of] adultery.

2.15.s:
na saṃbhāṣaṃ saha strībhiḥ pratiṣiddhaṃ samācaret ..
pratiṣiddhastu saṃbhāṣaḥ suvarṇaṃ daṇḍamarhati .. 105 ..
2.15.d:
न संभाषं सह स्त्रीभिः प्रतिषिद्धं समाचरेत् ॥
प्रतिषिद्धस्तु संभाषः सुवर्णं दण्डमर्हति ॥ 105 ॥
2.15.m: One must not engage in conversation with women when it is forbidden; / conversation that has been prohibited merits a fine of a suvarṇa.

2.15.s:
naiṣa cāreṇadāreṣu vidhirnātmopajīviṣu ..
sajjayanti manuṣyaiste nigūḍhaṃ vicarantyuta .. 106 ..
2.15.d:
नैष चारेणदारेषु विधिर्नात्मोपजीविषु ॥
सज्जयन्ति मनुष्यैस्ते निगूढं विचरन्त्युत ॥ 106 ॥
2.15.m: This rule does not apply to the wives of traveling actors, nor to those who live by their own [wives' charms]; / for they offer their women to men, and they wander about covertly.

2.15.s:
kiñcideva tu sakhyaṃ syātsaṃbhāṣetābhicārayan ..
preṣyāsu caiva sarvābhirahaḥ pravrajitāsu ca .. 107 ..
2.15.d:
किञ्चिदेव तु सख्यं स्यात्संभाषेताभिचारयन् ॥
प्रेष्यासु चैव सर्वाभिरहः प्रव्रजितासु च ॥ 107 ॥
2.15.m: If there is any [prior] friendship, one may converse after deliberation, / and [one may speak] with female servants, with all of them, and with female renunciants in secret.

2.15.s:
yo'kāmāṃ dūṣayetkanyāṃ sa sadyo vadhamarhati ..
sakāmāṃ dūṣayāṇastu prāpyaḥ prathamasāhasam .. 108 ..
2.15.d:
योऽकामां दूषयेत्कन्यां स सद्यो वधमर्हति ॥
सकामां दूषयाणस्तु प्राप्यः प्रथमसाहसम् ॥ 108 ॥
2.15.m: He who violates an unwilling maiden immediately merits death; / but he who violates a willing maiden is to be subjected to the first amercement.

2.15.s:
bhikṣuko'pyathavā nārī yo'pi ca syātkuśīlavaḥ ..
praviśetpratiṣiddhastu prāpnuyāddviśataṃ damam .. 109 ..
2.15.d:
भिक्षुकोऽप्यथवा नारी योऽपि च स्यात्कुशीलवः ॥
प्रविशेत्प्रतिषिद्धस्तु प्राप्नुयाद्द्विशतं दमम् ॥ 109 ॥
2.15.m: Whether a mendicant, or a woman, or also an actor, / if one enters when forbidden, one should receive a fine of two hundred [paṇas].

2.15.s:
yaśca saṃcārakastatra puruṣaḥ sa tathā bhavet ..
pāradārikavaddaṇḍyo yaśca syādavakāśadaḥ .. 2.72.110 ..
2.15.d:
यश्च संचारकस्तत्र पुरुषः स तथा भवेत् ॥
पारदारिकवद्दण्ड्यो यश्च स्यादवकाशदः ॥ 2.72.110 ॥
2.15.m: And the man who is a procurer there shall be treated likewise; / and he who provides a space shall be punished like an adulterer.

2.15.s:
balātsaṃdūṣayanyastu parabhāryāṃ naraḥ kvacit ..
vadhadaṇḍo bhavettasya nāparādho bhavetstriyāḥ .. 111 ..
2.15.d:
बलात्संदूषयन्यस्तु परभार्यां नरः क्वचित् ॥
वधदण्डो भवेत्तस्य नापराधो भवेत्स्त्रियाः ॥ 111 ॥
2.15.m: If any man forcibly violates another's wife anywhere, / his punishment shall be death, and there shall be no fault on the woman's part.

2.15.s:
rajastṛtīyaṃ yā kanyā svagṛhe pratipadyate ..
adaṇḍyā sā bhavedrājñā varayantī patiṃ svayam .. 112 ..
2.15.d:
रजस्तृतीयं या कन्या स्वगृहे प्रतिपद्यते ॥
अदण्ड्या सा भवेद्राज्ञा वरयन्ती पतिं स्वयम् ॥ 112 ॥
2.15.m: A maiden who attains her third menses in her own home / shall not be punished by the king if she chooses a husband herself.

2.15.s:
svadeśe kanyakāṃ dattvā tāmādāya tathā vrajan ..
paradeśe bhavedvadhyaḥ strīcauraḥ sa tathā bhavet .. 113 ..
2.15.d:
स्वदेशे कन्यकां दत्त्वा तामादाय तथा व्रजन् ॥
परदेशे भवेद्वध्यः स्त्रीचौरः स तथा भवेत् ॥ 113 ॥
2.15.m: Having given away a maiden in his own country, taking her and departing thus / into another country, he should be put to death, for he is a thief of women.

2.15.s:
adravyāṃ mṛtapatnīṃ tu saṃgṛhṇannāparādhyati ..
sārthāṃ vai tāṃ ca gṛhṇāno daṇḍamuttamamarhati .. 114 ..
2.15.d:
अद्रव्यां मृतपत्नीं तु संगृह्णन्नापराध्यति ॥
सार्थां वै तां च गृह्णानो दण्डमुत्तममर्हति ॥ 114 ॥
2.15.m: Taking in a destitute widow does not constitute an offense; / but taking her when she has wealth, one merits the highest amercement.

2.15.s:
utkṛṣṭaṃ yā bhajetkanyā deyā tasyaiva sā bhavet ..
jaghanyaṃ sevamānāṃ ca saṃyatāṃ vāsayedgṛhe .. 115 ..
2.15.d:
उत्कृष्टं या भजेत्कन्या देया तस्यैव सा भवेत् ॥
जघन्यं सेवमानां च संयतां वासयेद्गृहे ॥ 115 ॥
2.15.m: A maiden who attaches herself to a superior man should be given to that very man; / but one who consorts with an inferior man should be kept restrained in the house.

2.15.s:
uttamāṃ sevamānastu jaghanyo vadhamarhati ..
jaghanyamuttamā nārī sevamānā tathaiva ca .. 116 ..
2.15.d:
उत्तमां सेवमानस्तु जघन्यो वधमर्हति ॥
जघन्यमुत्तमा नारी सेवमाना तथैव च ॥ 116 ॥
2.15.m: An inferior man who consorts with a superior woman merits death; / likewise a superior woman who consorts with an inferior man.

2.15.s:
bhartāraṃ laṅghayedyā tu strī jñātibaladarpitā ..
tāṃ śvabhiḥ khādayedrājā saṃsthāne bahusaṃsthite .. 117 ..
2.15.d:
भर्तारं लङ्घयेद्या तु स्त्री ज्ञातिबलदर्पिता ॥
तां श्वभिः खादयेद्राजा संस्थाने बहुसंस्थिते ॥ 117 ॥
2.15.m: A woman who, proud of the strength of her kinsmen, transgresses against her husband— / the king should have her devoured by dogs in a public place frequented by many.

2.15.s:
hṛtādhikārāṃ malināṃ piṇḍamātropajīvinīm ..
vāsayetsvairiṇīṃ nityaṃ savarṇenābhidūṣitām .. 118 ..
2.15.d:
हृताधिकारां मलिनां पिण्डमात्रोपजीविनीम् ॥
वासयेत्स्वैरिणीं नित्यं सवर्णेनाभिदूषिताम् ॥ 118 ॥
2.15.m: Deprived of authority, wearing soiled garments, subsisting on bare food-balls, / an unchaste woman corrupted by a man of the same varṇa should always be kept [at home].

2.15.s:
jyāyasā dūṣitā nārī muṇḍanaṃ samavāpnuyāt ..
māsaṃ ca malinā nityaṃ sā grāsānprāpnuyāddaśa .. 119 ..
2.15.d:
ज्यायसा दूषिता नारी मुण्डनं समवाप्नुयात् ॥
मासं च मलिना नित्यं सा ग्रासान्प्राप्नुयाद्दश ॥ 119 ॥
2.15.m: A woman corrupted by a superior man shall undergo the shaving of her head; / and wearing soiled garments for a month, she shall daily receive [only] ten mouthfuls [of food].

2.15.s:
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣattriyo vaiśyaḥ kṣattraviṭśūdrayonayaḥ ...
vrajandāpyo bhavedrāma daṇḍa uttamasāhasam .. 2.72.120 ..
2.15.d:
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्त्रियो वैश्यः क्षत्त्रविट्शूद्रयोनयः ॥।
व्रजन्दाप्यो भवेद्राम दण्ड उत्तमसाहसम् ॥ 2.72.120 ॥
2.15.m: A brahmin, a kṣatriya, or a vaiśya who approaches women born of kṣatriya, vaiśya, or śūdra wombs / should be made to pay the highest amercement, O Rāma.

2.15.s:
vaiśyāgame tu viprasya kṣattriyasyantyajāgame ..
madhyamaṃ prathamaṃ vaiśyo daṇḍyaḥ śadrāgame bhavet .. 121 ..
2.15.d:
वैश्यागमे तु विप्रस्य क्षत्त्रियस्यन्त्यजागमे ॥
मध्यमं प्रथमं वैश्यो दण्ड्यः शद्रागमे भवेत् ॥ 121 ॥
2.15.m: Upon a brahmin's intercourse with a vaiśya woman, or a kṣatriya's with an outcaste woman, / the fine is the middling [amercement]; a vaiśya approaching a śūdra woman should be fined the first [amercement].

2.15.s:
śūdraḥ savarṇā'gamane śataṃ daṇḍyo mahībhujā ..
vaiśyaśca dviguṇaṃ rāma kṣattriyastriguṇaṃ tathā .. 122 ..
2.15.d:
शूद्रः सवर्णाऽगमने शतं दण्ड्यो महीभुजा ॥
वैश्यश्च द्विगुणं राम क्षत्त्रियस्त्रिगुणं तथा ॥ 122 ॥
2.15.m: A śūdra approaching a woman of the same varṇa should be fined one hundred by the king; / a vaiśya twice that, O Rāma, and a kṣatriya thrice that.

2.15.s:
brāhmaṇaśca bhaveddaṇḍyastathā rāma caturguṇam ..
guptāsveva bhaveddaṇḍamaguptāsvapi tatsmṛtam .. 123 ..
2.15.d:
ब्राह्मणश्च भवेद्दण्ड्यस्तथा राम चतुर्गुणम् ॥
गुप्तास्वेव भवेद्दण्डमगुप्तास्वपि तत्स्मृतम् ॥ 123 ॥
2.15.m: And a brahmin should be fined four times as much, O Rāma. / This punishment applies to guarded women, and is prescribed also for unguarded women.

2.15.s:
mātā mātṛṣvasā śvaśrūrmātulānī pitṛṣvasā ..
pitṛvyasakhiśiṣyastrī bhaginī tatsakhī tathā .. 124 ..
2.15.d:
माता मातृष्वसा श्वश्रूर्मातुलानी पितृष्वसा ॥
पितृव्यसखिशिष्यस्त्री भगिनी तत्सखी तथा ॥ 124 ॥
2.15.m: Mother, mother's sister, mother-in-law, maternal uncle's wife, father's sister, / paternal uncle's wife, friend's wife, pupil's wife, sister, and her female friend,

2.15.s:
bhāgineyī tathā caiva rājapatnī tathaiva ca ..
ityagamyāstu nirdiṣṭāstāsāṃ tu gamane naraḥ .. 125 ...
2.15.d:
भागिनेयी तथा चैव राजपत्नी तथैव च ॥
इत्यगम्यास्तु निर्दिष्टास्तासां तु गमने नरः ॥ 125 ॥।
2.15.m: likewise a sister's daughter, and likewise a king's wife— / these are declared to be unapproachable; in approaching them, a man,

2.15.s:
śiśnasyotkartanaṃ kṛtvā tatastu vadhamarhati ..
bhrātṛbhāryāgame pūrvāddaṇḍastu vadhamarhati .. 126 ..
2.15.d:
शिश्नस्योत्कर्तनं कृत्वा ततस्तु वधमर्हति ॥
भ्रातृभार्यागमे पूर्वाद्दण्डस्तु वधमर्हति ॥ 126 ॥
2.15.m: having had his penis cut off, then merits death; / upon intercourse with a brother's wife, following the earlier [punishment], the punishment merits death.

2.15.s:
caṇḍālīṃ vā śvapākīṃ vā gacchanvadhamavāpnuyāt ..
tiryagyonau tu govarjyaṃ maithunaṃ yo niṣevate .. 127 ..
2.15.d:
चण्डालीं वा श्वपाकीं वा गच्छन्वधमवाप्नुयात् ॥
तिर्यग्योनौ तु गोवर्ज्यं मैथुनं यो निषेवते ॥ 127 ॥
2.15.m: Approaching a Caṇḍāla or Śvapāka woman, one should suffer death. / But he who engages in copulation with an animal, excepting a cow,

2.15.s:
sa paṇaṃ prāpnuyāddaṇḍaṃ tasyāśca yavasodakam ..
suvarṇaṃ ca bhaveddaṇḍyo gāṃ vrajanmanujottama .. 128 ..
2.15.d:
स पणं प्राप्नुयाद्दण्डं तस्याश्च यवसोदकम् ॥
सुवर्णं च भवेद्दण्ड्यो गां व्रजन्मनुजोत्तम ॥ 128 ॥
2.15.m: shall incur a fine of one paṇa, and provide grass and water for it; / and approaching a cow, O best of men, one should be fined a suvarṇa.

2.15.s:
veśyāgāmī bhaveddaṇḍyo veśyāśulkasamaṃ paṇam ..
gṛhītvā vetanaṃ veśyā lobhādanyatra gacchati .. 129 ..
2.15.d:
वेश्यागामी भवेद्दण्ड्यो वेश्याशुल्कसमं पणम् ॥
गृहीत्वा वेतनं वेश्या लोभादन्यत्र गच्छति ॥ 129 ॥
2.15.m: One who approaches a courtesan [without paying] shall be fined a paṇa equal to the courtesan's fee; / if a courtesan, having accepted her wages, goes elsewhere out of greed,

2.15.s:
vetanaṃ dviguṇaṃ dadyāddaṇḍaṃ ca triguṇaṃ tathā ..
anyamuddiśya veśyāṃ yo nayedanyasya kāraṇāt .. 2.72.130 ..
2.15.d:
वेतनं द्विगुणं दद्याद्दण्डं च त्रिगुणं तथा ॥
अन्यमुद्दिश्य वेश्यां यो नयेदन्यस्य कारणात् ॥ 2.72.130 ॥
2.15.m: she shall give twice the wages, and likewise three times [that] as a fine. / One who procures a courtesan for one man on the pretext of another,

2.15.s:
tasya daṇḍaṃ bhavedrāma suvarṇasya ca māṣakam ..
nītvā bhogaṃ na yo dadyāddāpyo dviguṇavetanam .. 131 ..
2.15.d:
तस्य दण्डं भवेद्राम सुवर्णस्य च माषकम् ॥
नीत्वा भोगं न यो दद्याद्दाप्यो द्विगुणवेतनम् ॥ 131 ॥
2.15.m: his fine shall be a māṣaka of gold, O Rāma; / he who takes [her] and does not grant enjoyment should be made to pay twice the wages,

2.15.s:
rājñā ca dviguṇaṃ daṇḍyastathā dharmo na hīyate ..
bahūnāṃ vrajatāmekāṃ sarve taddviguṇaṃ damam .. 132 ..
2.15.d:
राज्ञा च द्विगुणं दण्ड्यस्तथा धर्मो न हीयते ॥
बहूनां व्रजतामेकां सर्वे तद्द्विगुणं दमम् ॥ 132 ॥
2.15.m: and should be fined twice [that] by the king; thus dharma is not violated. / When many men approach one [courtesan], all [suffer] twice that punishment;

2.15.s:
sarve pṛthakpṛthagrāma daṇḍaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ paṇāt ..
na mātā na pitā na strī ṛtvigyājyasya sūnavaḥ .. 133 ..
2.15.d:
सर्वे पृथक्पृथग्राम दण्डं च द्विगुणं पणात् ॥
न माता न पिता न स्त्री ऋत्विग्याज्यस्य सूनवः ॥ 133 ॥
2.15.m: all individually, O Rāma, [incur] a fine twice that from a paṇa. / Neither mother, nor father, nor wife, nor officiating priest, nor patron, nor sons

2.15.s:
anyonyāḥ patitāstyājyāstyāge daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ ..
patitā guravastyājyā na tu mātā kadācana ..134..
2.15.d:
अन्योन्याः पतितास्त्याज्यास्त्यागे दण्ड्यः शतानि षट् ॥
पतिता गुरवस्त्याज्या न तु माता कदाचन ॥134॥
2.15.m: should abandon one another unless fallen; for abandoning [them, one is] to be fined six hundred [paṇas]. / Fallen elders may be abandoned, but never a mother;

2.15.s:
garbhadhāraṇapoṣābhyāṃ tena mātā garīyasī ..
saṃdaṃśahīnau kartavyau kūṭākṣopadhidevinau .. 135 ..
2.15.d:
गर्भधारणपोषाभ्यां तेन माता गरीयसी ॥
संदंशहीनौ कर्तव्यौ कूटाक्षोपधिदेविनौ ॥ 135 ॥
2.15.m: because of bearing in the womb and nourishing, the mother is more venerable. / Two gamblers using loaded dice or deceit should be deprived of their thumbs.

2.15.s:
adhīyānamanadhyāye daṇḍaḥ karṣāpaṇatrayam ..
adhyāpakaśca dviguṇaṃ tathācārasya laṅghane .. 136 ..
2.15.d:
अधीयानमनध्याये दण्डः कर्षापणत्रयम् ॥
अध्यापकश्च द्विगुणं तथाचारस्य लङ्घने ॥ 136 ॥
2.15.m: For one who studies on a day when study is forbidden, the fine is three kārṣāpaṇas; / and the teacher [pays] twice that, likewise for transgressing proper conduct.

2.15.s:
antaṃ sasyabhave daṇḍaḥ suvarṇasya ca kṛṣṇalam ..
bhāryā putraśca dāsaśca śiṣyo bhrātā ca sodaraḥ .. 137 ..
2.15.d:
अन्तं सस्यभवे दण्डः सुवर्णस्य च कृष्णलम् ॥
भार्या पुत्रश्च दासश्च शिष्यो भ्राता च सोदरः ॥ 137 ॥
2.15.m: A fine of a kṛṣṇala of gold [is imposed] for destruction of crops. / A wife, a son, a slave, a pupil, and a uterine brother,

2.15.s:
prāptāparādhāste daṇḍyā rajvā veṇudalena vā ..
pṛṣṭhatastu śarīrasya nottamāṅge kathaṃcana .. 138 ..
2.15.d:
प्राप्तापराधास्ते दण्ड्या रज्वा वेणुदलेन वा ॥
पृष्ठतस्तु शरीरस्य नोत्तमाङ्गे कथंचन ॥ 138 ॥
2.15.m: when they have committed an offense, are to be punished with a rope or with a split bamboo, / but on the back of the body, never on the head.

2.15.s:
atonyathā yatpraharetprāptaḥ syāccaurakilbiṣam ..
dyūtaṃ samāhvayaṃ caiva yo niṣiddhaṃ samācaret .. 139 ..
2.15.d:
अतोन्यथा यत्प्रहरेत्प्राप्तः स्याच्चौरकिल्बिषम् ॥
द्यूतं समाह्वयं चैव यो निषिद्धं समाचरेत् ॥ 139 ॥
2.15.m: If one strikes otherwise than this, one incurs the guilt of a thief. / One who engages in gambling and betting when forbidden,

2.15.s:
pracchannaṃ vā prakāśaṃ vā sa daṇḍyaḥ pārthivecchayā ..
vāsāṃsi phalake ślakṣṇe nenijyādrajakaḥ śanaiḥ .. 2.72.140 ..
2.15.d:
प्रच्छन्नं वा प्रकाशं वा स दण्ड्यः पार्थिवेच्छया ॥
वासांसि फलके श्लक्ष्णे नेनिज्याद्रजकः शनैः ॥ 2.72.140 ॥
2.15.m: secretly or openly, should be punished at the king's pleasure. / A washerman should wash clothes gently on a smooth board;

2.15.s:
ato'nyathā tu kurvīta daṇḍassyādrukmakṛṣṇalam ..
rakṣāṃsyadhikṛtā rāma prajeyaṃ yairvilipyate .. 141 ..
2.15.d:
अतोऽन्यथा तु कुर्वीत दण्डस्स्याद्रुक्मकृष्णलम् ॥
रक्षांस्यधिकृता राम प्रजेयं यैर्विलिप्यते ॥ 141 ॥
2.15.m: if he acts otherwise, the fine shall be a kṛṣṇala of gold. / Those officials appointed as protectors, O Rāma, by whom this citizenry is preyed upon,

2.15.s:
kāryikebhyo'rthamādāya hanyuḥ kāryāṇi kāryiṇām ..
teṣāṃ sarvasvamādāya rājā kuryātpravāsanam .. 142 ..
2.15.d:
कार्यिकेभ्योऽर्थमादाय हन्युः कार्याणि कार्यिणाम् ॥
तेषां सर्वस्वमादाय राजा कुर्यात्प्रवासनम् ॥ 142 ॥
2.15.m: who, having taken money from litigants, ruin the suits of the litigants— / confiscating all their property, the king should banish them.

2.15.s:
ye niyuktāḥ svakāryeṣu hanyuḥ kāryāṇi kāryiṇām ..
nirghṛṇāḥ krūramanasaḥ sarvakāryoparodhinaḥ .. 143 ..
2.15.d:
ये नियुक्ताः स्वकार्येषु हन्युः कार्याणि कार्यिणाम् ॥
निर्घृणाः क्रूरमनसः सर्वकार्योपरोधिनः ॥ 143 ॥
2.15.m: Those who, appointed to their duties, ruin the affairs of litigants, / merciless, cruel-minded, obstructers of all business,

2.15.s:
dhanoṣmaṇā pacyamānāṃstānniḥsvānkārayennṛpaḥ ..
kūṭaśāsanakartṝṃśca prakṛtīnāṃ ca dūṣakān .. 144 ..
2.15.d:
धनोष्मणा पच्यमानांस्तान्निःस्वान्कारयेन्नृपः ॥
कूटशासनकर्तॄंश्च प्रकृतीनां च दूषकान् ॥ 144 ॥
2.15.m: being consumed by the heat of wealth—the king should make them destitute; / and those who forge royal edicts, and corrupters of the subjects,

2.15.s:
strībālabrāhmaṇaghnāṃśca vadhyāṃścāsevinastathā ..
amātyaḥ prāḍvivāko vā yaḥ kuryātkāryamanyathā .. 145 ..
2.15.d:
स्त्रीबालब्राह्मणघ्नांश्च वध्यांश्चासेविनस्तथा ॥
अमात्यः प्राड्विवाको वा यः कुर्यात्कार्यमन्यथा ॥ 145 ॥
2.15.m: and slayers of women, children, and brahmins, and those who associate with criminals condemned to death; / or a minister or a judge who decides a case wrongfully,

2.15.s:
tasya sarvasvamādāya taṃ rājā vipravāsayet ..
brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ .. 146 ..
2.15.d:
तस्य सर्वस्वमादाय तं राजा विप्रवासयेत् ॥
ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापश्च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः ॥ 146 ॥
2.15.m: taking all his property, the king should banish him. / A killer of a brahmin, a drinker of liquor, a thief, and one who violates his guru's bed—

2.15.s:
etānsarvānpṛthagvidyānmahāpātakino narān ..
mahāpātakino vadhyā brāhmaṇaṃ tu vivāsayet .. 147 ..
2.15.d:
एतान्सर्वान्पृथग्विद्यान्महापातकिनो नरान् ॥
महापातकिनो वध्या ब्राह्मणं तु विवासयेत् ॥ 147 ॥
2.15.m: all these men one should know individually as committers of major sins. / Committers of major sins are to be executed; but a brahmin he should banish

2.15.s:
kṛtacihnaṃ svakāddeśācchṛṇu cihnakramaṃ tathā..
gurutalpe bhagaḥ kāryaḥ surāpāne surādhvajaḥ .. 148 ..
2.15.d:
कृतचिह्नं स्वकाद्देशाच्छृणु चिह्नक्रमं तथा॥
गुरुतल्पे भगः कार्यः सुरापाने सुराध्वजः ॥ 148 ॥
2.15.m: from his country after branding him with a mark. Hear also the order of marks: / for violating a guru's bed, a female organ is to be made; for drinking liquor, the flag of liquor;

2.15.s:
steye tu śvapadaṃ vidyādbrahmahaṇyaśirāḥ pumān ..
asambhāṣyā hyasaṃlāpyā asampādyā viśeṣataḥ .. 149 ..
2.15.d:
स्तेये तु श्वपदं विद्याद्ब्रह्महण्यशिराः पुमान् ॥
असम्भाष्या ह्यसंलाप्या असम्पाद्या विशेषतः ॥ 149 ॥
2.15.m: for theft, one should know a dog's foot; for killing a brahmin, a headless human body. / They are not to be spoken to, nor conversed with, and especially not to be associated with;

2.15.s:
tyaktavyāśca tathā rāma! jñātisambandhibāndhavaiḥ ..
mahāpātakino vittamādāya nṛpatiḥ svayam .. 2.72.150 ..
2.15.d:
त्यक्तव्याश्च तथा राम! ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिबान्धवैः ॥
महापातकिनो वित्तमादाय नृपतिः स्वयम् ॥ 2.72.150 ॥
2.15.m: and they must be abandoned, O Rāma, by kin, relations, and friends. / Taking the wealth of a committer of a major sin himself, the king

2.15.s:
apsu praveśayeddaṇḍaṃ varuṇāyopapādayet ..
sahoḍhaṃ na vinā cauraṃ ghātayeddhārmiko nṛpaḥ .. 151 ..
2.15.d:
अप्सु प्रवेशयेद्दण्डं वरुणायोपपादयेत् ॥
सहोढं न विना चौरं घातयेद्धार्मिको नृपः ॥ 151 ॥
2.15.m: should cast that fine into the waters, dedicating it to Varuṇa. / A righteous king should not put a thief to death without the stolen goods;

2.15.s:
sahoḍhaṃ sopakaraṇaṃ ghātayedavicārayan..
grāmeṣvapi ca ye keciccaurāṇāṃ bhaktadāyakāḥ .. 152 ..
2.15.d:
सहोढं सोपकरणं घातयेदविचारयन्॥
ग्रामेष्वपि च ये केचिच्चौराणां भक्तदायकाः ॥ 152 ॥
2.15.m: found with the stolen goods and the implements, he should put him to death without hesitation. / And whosoever in the villages provide food to thieves,

2.15.s:
bhāṇḍāvakāśadāścaiva sarvāṃstānapi ghātayet ..
rāṣṭreṣu rāṣṭrādhipateḥ samantāccaiva dūṣakān .. 153 ..
2.15.d:
भाण्डावकाशदाश्चैव सर्वांस्तानपि घातयेत् ॥
राष्ट्रेषु राष्ट्राधिपतेः समन्ताच्चैव दूषकान् ॥ 153 ॥
2.15.m: and those who provide space for stolen goods—all of them too he should put to death; / and throughout the realms, those who corrupt the ruler of the realm all around,

2.15.s:
abhyāghāteṣu madhyasthāḥ kṣipraṃ śāsyāstu cauravat ..
dasyuprapīḍitānāṃ hi pathi mohādidarśane .. 154 ...
2.15.d:
अभ्याघातेषु मध्यस्थाः क्षिप्रं शास्यास्तु चौरवत् ॥
दस्युप्रपीडितानां हि पथि मोहादिदर्शने ॥ 154 ॥।
2.15.m: and those who remain indifferent during attacks, are to be punished swiftly like thieves. / Indeed, when people on the road are oppressed by bandits, on seeing their distress,

2.15.s:
śaktitonābhidhāvanto nirvāsyāḥ saparicchadāḥ ..
rājñaḥ koṣāpahartṝṃśca pratikūleṣu ca sthitān ..195 ..
2.15.d:
शक्तितोनाभिधावन्तो निर्वास्याः सपरिच्छदाः ॥
राज्ञः कोषापहर्तॄंश्च प्रतिकूलेषु च स्थितान् ॥195 ॥
2.15.m: those who do not run to help according to their strength are to be banished along with their belongings. / And embezzlers of the king's treasury, and those who side with adversaries,

2.15.s:
arīṇāmupajaptṝm̐śca ghātayedvividhairvadhaiḥ ..
sandhiṃ bhittvā tu ye cauryaṃ rājñaḥ kurvaṃti taskarāḥ .. 156 ..
2.15.d:
अरीणामुपजप्तॄम्̐श्च घातयेद्विविधैर्वधैः ॥
सन्धिं भित्त्वा तु ये चौर्यं राज्ञः कुर्वंति तस्कराः ॥ 156 ॥
2.15.m: and instigators acting for enemies he should put to death by various forms of execution. / But thieves who commit burglary by breaking through a wall against the king,

2.15.s:
teṣāṃ chittvā nṛpo hastau tīkṣṇe śūle niveśayet ..
taḍākabhedakaṃ hanyādapsu śuddhavadhena tu ..157..
2.15.d:
तेषां छित्त्वा नृपो हस्तौ तीक्ष्णे शूले निवेशयेत् ॥
तडाकभेदकं हन्यादप्सु शुद्धवधेन तु ॥157॥
2.15.m: cutting off both their hands, the king should impale them on a sharp stake. / A destroyer of a reservoir he should kill by simple drowning in the waters.

2.15.s:
yastu pūrvaṃ nivṛttasya taḍākasyodakaṃ haret ..
āgamaṃ vāpyapāṃ kuryātsa dāpyaḥ pūrvasāhasam ..158..
2.15.d:
यस्तु पूर्वं निवृत्तस्य तडाकस्योदकं हरेत् ॥
आगमं वाप्यपां कुर्यात्स दाप्यः पूर्वसाहसम् ॥158॥
2.15.m: Whoever takes the water of a previously abandoned reservoir, / or creates an inflow of water, is to be made to pay the first violent penalty.

2.15.s:
koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgāradevatāgārabhedakān ..
pāpānpāpasamācārānghātayecchīghrameva tān..159..
2.15.d:
कोष्ठागारायुधागारदेवतागारभेदकान् ॥
पापान्पापसमाचारान्घातयेच्छीघ्रमेव तान्॥159॥
2.15.m: Breakers of storehouses, armouries, and temples— / those wicked people of wicked conduct he should put to death immediately.

2.15.s:
samutsṛjedrājamārge yastvamedhyamanāpadi ..
sa hi kārṣāpaṇaṃ daṇḍyastamamedhyaṃ ca śodhayet.. ..2.72.160..
2.15.d:
समुत्सृजेद्राजमार्गे यस्त्वमेध्यमनापदि ॥
स हि कार्षापणं दण्ड्यस्तममेध्यं च शोधयेत्॥ ॥2.72.160॥
2.15.m: He who discharges filth on the royal highway when not in distress / is to be fined a kārṣāpaṇa and must clean up that filth.

2.15.s:
āpadgato'thavā vṛddho garbhiṇī bāla eva vā ..
paribhāṣaṇamarhanti tacca śodhyamiti sthitiḥ..161..
2.15.d:
आपद्गतोऽथवा वृद्धो गर्भिणी बाल एव वा ॥
परिभाषणमर्हन्ति तच्च शोध्यमिति स्थितिः॥161॥
2.15.m: One who is in distress, an elderly person, a pregnant woman, or a child / deserves a reprimand, and that [filth] must be cleaned up: such is the rule.

2.15.s:
prathamaṃ sāhasaṃ daṇḍyaḥ yaśca mithyācikitsakaḥ ..
puruṣe madhyamaṃ daṇḍyastūttame ca tathottamam ..162..
2.15.d:
प्रथमं साहसं दण्ड्यः यश्च मिथ्याचिकित्सकः ॥
पुरुषे मध्यमं दण्ड्यस्तूत्तमे च तथोत्तमम् ॥162॥
2.15.m: A false physician is to be fined the first violent penalty [on an animal]; / on an [ordinary] person, he is to be fined the middle [penalty], and on an eminent person, the highest.

2.15.s:
saṃkramadhvajayaṣṭīnāṃ pratimānāṃ ca bhedakān ..
pratikuryuśca tatsarvaṃ dadyuḥ pañcaśatāni ca..163..
2.15.d:
संक्रमध्वजयष्टीनां प्रतिमानां च भेदकान् ॥
प्रतिकुर्युश्च तत्सर्वं दद्युः पञ्चशतानि च॥163॥
2.15.m: Destroyers of bridges, flagstaffs, and images / must repair all of that and pay five hundred [paṇas].

2.15.s:
adūṣitānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dūṣaṇe bhedane tathā ..
maṇīnāmapi bhedasya daṇḍaḥ prathamasāhasaḥ .. 164 ..
2.15.d:
अदूषितानां द्रव्याणां दूषणे भेदने तथा ॥
मणीनामपि भेदस्य दण्डः प्रथमसाहसः ॥ 164 ॥
2.15.m: For adulterating unadulterated goods, as well as breaking them, / and also for breaking gemstones, the penalty is the first violent penalty.

2.15.s:
samaiśca viṣamaṃ yo vai kurute mūlyato'pi vā ..
samāpnuyānnaraḥ pūrvaṃ samaṃ vādhamameva vā .. 165 ..
2.15.d:
समैश्च विषमं यो वै कुरुते मूल्यतोऽपि वा ॥
समाप्नुयान्नरः पूर्वं समं वाधममेव वा ॥ 165 ॥
2.15.m: A man who makes unequal what is equal, even in terms of price, / shall incur the first [penalty], or equal, or the lowest.

2.15.s:
bandhanāni ca sarvāṇi rājamārge niveśayet ..
kliśyanto yatra dṛśyante vikṛtāḥ pāpacāriṇaḥ .. 166 ..
2.15.d:
बन्धनानि च सर्वाणि राजमार्गे निवेशयेत् ॥
क्लिश्यन्तो यत्र दृश्यन्ते विकृताः पापचारिणः ॥ 166 ॥
2.15.m: And he should establish all prisons along the royal highway, / where wrongdoers are seen suffering and deformed.

2.15.s:
prākārasya tu bhettāraṃ parikhānāṃ ca bhedakam ..
dvārāṇāṃ caiva bhettāraṃ kṣipraṃ nirvāsayetpurāt .. 167 ..
2.15.d:
प्राकारस्य तु भेत्तारं परिखानां च भेदकम् ॥
द्वाराणां चैव भेत्तारं क्षिप्रं निर्वासयेत्पुरात् ॥ 167 ॥
2.15.m: The breaker of a city wall, the filler-up of moats, / and the breaker of city gates he should swiftly banish from the city.

2.15.s:
mūlakarmābhicāreṣu kartavyo dviguṇo damaḥ ..
abījavikrayī daivabījotkṛṣṭastathaiva ca .. 168 ..
2.15.d:
मूलकर्माभिचारेषु कर्तव्यो द्विगुणो दमः ॥
अबीजविक्रयी दैवबीजोत्कृष्टस्तथैव च ॥ 168 ॥
2.15.m: In cases of sorcery with roots and malevolent rites, a double fine is to be imposed. / A seller of non-viable seed, and one who digs up sown seed,

2.15.s:
maryādābhedakaścaiva vikṛtaṃ vadhamāpnuyāt ..
sarvasaṅkarapāpiṣṭhaṃ hemakāraṃ narādhipaḥ .. 169 ..
2.15.d:
मर्यादाभेदकश्चैव विकृतं वधमाप्नुयात् ॥
सर्वसङ्करपापिष्ठं हेमकारं नराधिपः ॥ 169 ॥
2.15.m: and a violator of boundaries shall receive a mutilated death. / A goldsmith who is the most sinful of all adulterators,

2.15.s:
anyāye vartamānaṃ tu lavaśaśchedayeccharaiḥ ..
dravyamādāya vaṇijāmanargheṇāvarundhatām .. 2.72.170 ..
2.15.d:
अन्याये वर्तमानं तु लवशश्छेदयेच्छरैः ॥
द्रव्यमादाय वणिजामनर्घेणावरुन्धताम् ॥ 2.72.170 ॥
2.15.m: persisting in unlawful conduct, the king should have cut to pieces with arrows. / For taking the goods of merchants and detaining them unfairly,

2.15.s:
rājā pṛthakpṛthakkuryāddaṇḍamuttamasāhasam ..
dvyāvadūṣako yaśca praticchandakavikrayī.. 171 ..
2.15.d:
राजा पृथक्पृथक्कुर्याद्दण्डमुत्तमसाहसम् ॥
द्व्यावदूषको यश्च प्रतिच्छन्दकविक्रयी॥ 171 ॥
2.15.m: the king should impose the highest violent penalty on each separately. / One who adulterates yarn, and a seller of counterfeit goods,

2.15.s:
madhyamaṃ prāpnuyāddaṇḍaṃ kūṭakartā tathottamam ..
śāstrāṇāṃ yajñatapasāṃ deśānāṃ kṣepako naraḥ .. 172 ..
2.15.d:
मध्यमं प्राप्नुयाद्दण्डं कूटकर्ता तथोत्तमम् ॥
शास्त्राणां यज्ञतपसां देशानां क्षेपको नरः ॥ 172 ॥
2.15.m: shall incur the middle penalty, and a counterfeiter the highest. / A man who insults the scriptures, sacrifices, austerities, and countries,

2.15.s:
devatānāṃ satīnāṃ vai tūttamaṃ daṇḍamarhati ..
ekasya daṇḍapāruṣye bahūnāṃ dviguṇo damaḥ ..173 ..
2.15.d:
देवतानां सतीनां वै तूत्तमं दण्डमर्हति ॥
एकस्य दण्डपारुष्ये बहूनां द्विगुणो दमः ॥173 ॥
2.15.m: and deities, and virtuous women, deserves the highest penalty. / In physical injury of one person, the fine for several is double.

2.15.s:
kalahāpahṛtaṃ deyaṃ daṇḍaśca dviguṇastataḥ ..
madhyamaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ rājā viṣayādvipravāsayet .. 174 ..
2.15.d:
कलहापहृतं देयं दण्डश्च द्विगुणस्ततः ॥
मध्यमं ब्राह्मणं राजा विषयाद्विप्रवासयेत् ॥ 174 ॥
2.15.m: What is taken in a quarrel must be returned, and a fine twice that [amount imposed]. / A middling brahmin the king should banish from the realm.

2.15.s:
laśunaṃ ca palāṇḍuṃ ca sūkaraṃ grāmakukkuṭam ..
tathā pañcanakhaṃ sarvaṃ bhakṣyādanyatra bhakṣiṇam .. 175 ..
2.15.d:
लशुनं च पलाण्डुं च सूकरं ग्रामकुक्कुटम् ॥
तथा पञ्चनखं सर्वं भक्ष्यादन्यत्र भक्षिणम् ॥ 175 ॥
2.15.m: One who eats garlic, onion, pig, village fowl, / and all five-toed animals other than what is permitted to be eaten—

2.15.s:
vivāsayetkṣiprameva brāhmaṇaṃ viṣayātsvakāt ..
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇe daṇḍyaḥ śūdro bhavati kṛṣṇalam .. 176 ..
2.15.d:
विवासयेत्क्षिप्रमेव ब्राह्मणं विषयात्स्वकात् ॥
अभक्ष्यभक्षणे दण्ड्यः शूद्रो भवति कृष्णलम् ॥ 176 ॥
2.15.m: such a brahmin he should banish swiftly from his realm. / In the eating of uneatable food, a śūdra is to be fined a kṛṣṇala;

2.15.s:
brāhmaṇakṣattriyaviśāṃ catustridviguṇaṃ hitam ..
yaḥ sāhasaṃ kārayati sa dadyāddviguṇa damam .. 177 ..
2.15.d:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्त्रियविशां चतुस्त्रिद्विगुणं हितम् ॥
यः साहसं कारयति स दद्याद्द्विगुण दमम् ॥ 177 ॥
2.15.m: for brahmins, kṣatriyas, and vaiśyas, four, three, and two times as much is prescribed. / He who causes a violent act to be done shall pay double the fine;

2.15.s:
yaścedamuktvāhaṃ dātā kārayetsa caturguṇam ..
saṃdiṣṭasyāpradātāraṃ samudragṛhabhedakam .. 178 ..
2.15.d:
यश्चेदमुक्त्वाहं दाता कारयेत्स चतुर्गुणम् ॥
संदिष्टस्याप्रदातारं समुद्रगृहभेदकम् ॥ 178 ॥
2.15.m: and he who causes it saying, 'I will pay for it,' shall pay fourfold. / For one who does not deliver what was entrusted, and a breaker of a sealed house,

2.15.s:
pañcāśatpaṇiko daṃḍastayoḥ kāryo mahīkṣitā ..
aspṛśyeṣu śatārdhantu madhyo'dho yogakarmakṛt .. 179 ..
2.15.d:
पञ्चाशत्पणिको दंडस्तयोः कार्यो महीक्षिता ॥
अस्पृश्येषु शतार्धन्तु मध्योऽधो योगकर्मकृत् ॥ 179 ॥
2.15.m: a fine of fifty paṇas is to be imposed on both by the ruler of the earth. / Half of a hundred [paṇas] for untouchable matters, and a practitioner of middle and low magical devices,

2.15.s:
puṃstvahartā paśūnāṃ ca dāsīgarbhavināśakṛt ..
śūdrapravrajitānāṃ ca daive pitrye ca bhojakaḥ .. 2.72.180..
2.15.d:
पुंस्त्वहर्ता पशूनां च दासीगर्भविनाशकृत् ॥
शूद्रप्रव्रजितानां च दैवे पित्र्ये च भोजकः ॥ 2.72.180॥
2.15.m: and a castrater of animals, and a destroyer of a female slave's embryo, / and one who feeds śūdra ascetics in rites to the gods or ancestors,

2.15.s:
avrajanbāḍhamuktvā ca tathaiva ca nimantraṇāt ..
ete kārṣāpaṇaśataṃ sarve daṇḍyā mahīkṣitā .. 181 ..
2.15.d:
अव्रजन्बाढमुक्त्वा च तथैव च निमन्त्रणात् ॥
एते कार्षापणशतं सर्वे दण्ड्या महीक्षिता ॥ 181 ॥
2.15.m: and not going after having said 'yes' to an invitation— / all these are to be fined a hundred kārṣāpaṇas by the ruler of the earth.

2.15.s:
duḥkhotpādi gṛhe dravyaṃ kṣipandaṇḍyastu kṛṣṇalam ..
pitāputravirodhe tu sākṣiṇāṃ dviśato damaḥ .. 182 ..
2.15.d:
दुःखोत्पादि गृहे द्रव्यं क्षिपन्दण्ड्यस्तु कृष्णलम् ॥
पितापुत्रविरोधे तु साक्षिणां द्विशतो दमः ॥ 182 ॥
2.15.m: Throwing an injury-causing substance into a house, one is to be fined a kṛṣṇala. / In a dispute between father and son, the fine for witnesses is two hundred [paṇas].

2.15.s:
tulāśāsanamānānāṃ kūṭakṛnnāṇakasya ca ..
ebhiśca vyavahartā yaḥ sa dāpyo daṇḍamuttamam .. 183 ..
2.15.d:
तुलाशासनमानानां कूटकृन्नाणकस्य च ॥
एभिश्च व्यवहर्ता यः स दाप्यो दण्डमुत्तमम् ॥ 183 ॥
2.15.m: A falsifier of balances, edicts, and measures, and of coinage, / and whoever transacts with these, is to be made to pay the highest penalty.

2.15.s:
viṣāgnidāṃ patigurunijāpatyapramāpaṇīm ..
vikarṇakaranāsauṣṭhīṃ kṛtvā gobhiḥ pramāpayet .. 184 ..
2.15.d:
विषाग्निदां पतिगुरुनिजापत्यप्रमापणीम् ॥
विकर्णकरनासौष्ठीं कृत्वा गोभिः प्रमापयेत् ॥ 184 ॥
2.15.m: A woman who administers poison or fire, who kills her husband, elders, or own offspring, / having cut off her ears, hands, nose, and lips, he should cause to be killed by cattle.

2.15.s:
kṣetraveśmagrāmavananivītakhaladāhakāḥ ..
rājapatnyabhigāmī ca dagdhavyāśca kaṭāgninā .. 185 ..
2.15.d:
क्षेत्रवेश्मग्रामवननिवीतखलदाहकाः ॥
राजपत्न्यभिगामी च दग्धव्याश्च कटाग्निना ॥ 185 ॥
2.15.m: Burners of fields, houses, villages, forests, pastures, and threshing-floors, / and one who approaches the king's wife, are to be burned with a fire of straw mats.

2.15.s:
ūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi likhedyo rājaśāsanam ..
pāradārikacaurau ca muñcato daṇḍamuttamam .. 186 ..
2.15.d:
ऊनं वाप्यधिकं वापि लिखेद्यो राजशासनम् ॥
पारदारिकचौरौ च मुञ्चतो दण्डमुत्तमम् ॥ 186 ॥
2.15.m: Whoever writes less or more in a royal edict, / and one who releases an adulterer or a thief, incurs the highest penalty.

2.15.s:
abhakṣyeṇa dvijaṃ dūṣya daṇḍamuttamasāhasam ..
kṣatriyo madhyamaṃ vaiśyaḥ prathamaṃ śūdramardhikam .. 187..
2.15.d:
अभक्ष्येण द्विजं दूष्य दण्डमुत्तमसाहसम् ॥
क्षत्रियो मध्यमं वैश्यः प्रथमं शूद्रमर्धिकम् ॥ 187॥
2.15.m: For polluting a twice-born with inedible food, the fine is the highest penalty for violence; / for a kṣatriya, the middle; for a vaiśya, the lowest; and for a śūdra, half of that.

2.15.s:
mṛtāṅgalagnavikreturgurostāḍayitustathā..
rājayānāsanāroḍhurdaṇḍa uttamasāhasaḥ .. .. 188 ..
2.15.d:
मृताङ्गलग्नविक्रेतुर्गुरोस्ताडयितुस्तथा॥
राजयानासनारोढुर्दण्ड उत्तमसाहसः ॥ ॥ 188 ॥
2.15.m: For selling articles attached to the limbs of a corpse, for striking a teacher, / and for mounting a royal vehicle or seat, the fine is the highest penalty for violence.

2.15.s:
yo manyetājito'smīti nyāyenāpi parājitaḥ ...
tamāyātaṃ punarjitvā daṇḍadyeddviguṇaṃ damam..189..
2.15.d:
यो मन्येताजितोऽस्मीति न्यायेनापि पराजितः ॥।
तमायातं पुनर्जित्वा दण्डद्येद्द्विगुणं दमम्॥189॥
2.15.m: One who, though defeated in accordance with justice, thinks 'I am not defeated,' / when he returns after being defeated again, he should be fined twice the penalty.

2.15.s:
āhvānakārī vadhyaḥ syādanāhūtamathāhvayan..
daṇḍikasya yo hastādabhiyuktaḥ palāyate..2.72.190..
2.15.d:
आह्वानकारी वध्यः स्यादनाहूतमथाह्वयन्॥
दण्डिकस्य यो हस्तादभियुक्तः पलायते॥2.72.190॥
2.15.m: A summoner who summons someone not summoned deserves to be put to death. / When an accused person escapes from the hands of the officer of justice,

2.15.s:
hīnaḥ puruṣakāreṇa taddadyāddāṇḍiko dhanam..
preṣyāparādhātpreṣyasya sa daṇḍaṃ dātumarhati .. 191 ..
2.15.d:
हीनः पुरुषकारेण तद्दद्याद्दाण्डिको धनम्॥
प्रेष्यापराधात्प्रेष्यस्य स दण्डं दातुमर्हति ॥ 191 ॥
2.15.m: if the officer is lacking in human effort, he must pay that money. / Through the fault of an attendant, that attendant deserves to pay the fine.

2.15.s:
daṇḍārthaṃ niyamārthaṃ ca nīyamānastu bandhanam ..
pathi kaścitpalāyeta daṇḍamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet .. 192 .
2.15.d:
दण्डार्थं नियमार्थं च नीयमानस्तु बन्धनम् ॥
पथि कश्चित्पलायेत दण्डमष्टगुणं भवेत् ॥ 192 ।
2.15.m: If anyone being led to prison for punishment or restraint / should escape on the way, the fine shall be eightfold.

2.15.s:
aniṣṭhitavivāde tu nakharomāvatāraṇam ..
kārayedyaḥ sa puruṣo madhyamaṃ daṇḍamarhati .. 193 ..
2.15.d:
अनिष्ठितविवादे तु नखरोमावतारणम् ॥
कारयेद्यः स पुरुषो मध्यमं दण्डमर्हति ॥ 193 ॥
2.15.m: If a man causes the cutting off of nails or hair / while a lawsuit is still pending, he deserves the middle fine.

2.15.s:
bandhanaṃ vāthavā vadhyaṃ balānmocayato bhavet ..
vadhye vimocite vadhyo daṇḍye dviguṇadaṇḍabhāk .. 194 ..
2.15.d:
बन्धनं वाथवा वध्यं बलान्मोचयतो भवेत् ॥
वध्ये विमोचिते वध्यो दण्ड्ये द्विगुणदण्डभाक् ॥ 194 ॥
2.15.m: [A punishment] shall fall on one who forcibly releases someone imprisoned or condemned to death: / if one condemned to death is released, he must be put to death; if one sentenced to a fine, he shall incur twice the fine.

2.15.s:
durmṛṣṭavyavahārāṇāṃ sabhyānāṃ dviguṇo damaḥ ..
jñātvā triṃśadguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ prakṣepyamudake bhavet.. .. 195 ..
2.15.d:
दुर्मृष्टव्यवहाराणां सभ्यानां द्विगुणो दमः ॥
ज्ञात्वा त्रिंशद्गुणं दण्डं प्रक्षेप्यमुदके भवेत्॥ ॥ 195 ॥
2.15.m: For assessors of court who conduct lawsuits wrongly, the fine is double. / Having ascertained it, a thirtyfold fine should be cast into the water.

2.15.s:
alpe daṇḍedhikaṃ kṛtvā vipule cālpameva ca ..
ūnādhikaṃ tu taddaṇḍaṃ sadyo dadyātsvakādgṛhāt .. 196 ..
2.15.d:
अल्पे दण्डेधिकं कृत्वा विपुले चाल्पमेव च ॥
ऊनाधिकं तु तद्दण्डं सद्यो दद्यात्स्वकाद्गृहात् ॥ 196 ॥
2.15.m: By making a fine greater when it should be small, and small when it should be large, / [the king] must immediately pay that deficient or excessive fine from his own house.

2.15.s:
yāvadvadhyaḥ sa vadhyeta tāvadvadhyasya mokṣaṇāt ..
na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyātsarvapāpeṣvavasthitam .. 197 ..
2.15.d:
यावद्वध्यः स वध्येत तावद्वध्यस्य मोक्षणात् ॥
न जातु ब्राह्मणं हन्यात्सर्वपापेष्ववस्थितम् ॥ 197 ॥
2.15.m: [One shall be punished] as long as one condemned to death is killed, because of the release of one condemned to death. / One must never kill a brahmin, [even] if he is engaged in all sins.

2.15.s:
vadhye vivāsayedrāṣṭrātsamagradhanamakṣatam ..
na jātu brāhmaṇavadhātpāpamapyadhikaṃ kvacit .. 198 ..
2.15.d:
वध्ये विवासयेद्राष्ट्रात्समग्रधनमक्षतम् ॥
न जातु ब्राह्मणवधात्पापमप्यधिकं क्वचित् ॥ 198 ॥
2.15.m: When he deserves death, [the king] should banish him from the kingdom with all his wealth intact and unharmed; / for there is nowhere any sin greater than the killing of a brahmin.

2.15.s:
yasmāttasmātprayatnena brahmahatyāṃ vivarjayet ..
adaṇḍyāndaṇḍayanrājā daṇḍyāṃścaivāpyadaṇḍayan ..
ayaśomahadāpnoti narakaṃ caiva gacchati .. 199 ..
2.15.d:
यस्मात्तस्मात्प्रयत्नेन ब्रह्महत्यां विवर्जयेत् ॥
अदण्ड्यान्दण्डयन्राजा दण्ड्यांश्चैवाप्यदण्डयन् ॥
अयशोमहदाप्नोति नरकं चैव गच्छति ॥ 199 ॥
2.15.m: Therefore, one should avoid the murder of a brahmin with effort. / A king who punishes those who should not be punished, and does not punish those who should be punished, / incurs great infamy and goes to hell.

2.15.s:
jñātvāparādhaṃ puruṣaṃ ca rājā kālaṃ tathā cānumate dvijānām ..
daṇḍyeṣu daṇḍaṃ parikalpayeta pāpasya ye tacchamanaṃ na kuryuḥ .. 2.72.200 ..
2.73
rāma uvāca ..
kuryāddaṇḍapraṇayanaṃ prāyaścittamakurvatām ..
nṛṇāṃ rājā tato brūhi prāyaścittavidhiṃ mama .. 1 ..
puṣkara uvāca ..
akāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ..
kāmacārakṛte'pyetanmataṃ me śrutidarśanāt .. 2..
prāyaścittaiḥ śamaṃ yāti pāpaṃ kṛtamasaṃśayam ..
rājadaṇḍācchamaṃ yāti prāyaścittamakurvatām .. 3 ..
prāyaścittavihīnā ye rājabhiścāpyavāsitāḥ ..
narakaṃ pratipadyante tiryagyoniṃ tathaiva ca .. 4 ..
mānuṣyamapi cāsādya bhavantīha tathāṃkitāḥ ..
prāyaścittamataḥ kāryaṃ kalmaṣasyāpanuttaye..5..
rājakruddhāturānnaṃ ca na bhuñjīta kadācana ..

2.15.m:
Having ascertained the crime, the person, and the time, with the consent of twice-borns, / the king should impose punishment on those deserving of punishment who do not expiate their sin.
Rāma said: / The king should inflict punishment on men who do not perform expiation; / therefore, tell me the rule of expiation.
Puṣkara said: / The wise know expiation to be for a sin committed unintentionally; / but even when done intentionally, this is my view from the testimony of revelation.
Through expiations, a sin that has been committed is undoubtedly pacified; / through the king's punishment, it is pacified for those who do not perform expiation.
Those who are devoid of expiation, and are also not punished by kings, / go to hell, and likewise into the wombs of animals.
Even when they attain human birth, they are marked in this world accordingly. / Therefore, expiation must be performed for the removal of defilement.
One should never eat the food of a king, of one who is angry, or of one who is sick, / nor the food of a summoner, or food touched intentionally with a foot,
