अङ्गारकदिनं वर्ज्यं तिथिं रिक्तां च वर्जयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
अच्छिन्ननाभ्यां कर्तव्यं जातकर्म विचक्षणैः ॥
आशौचे तु व्यतिक्रान्ते नामकर्म विधीयते ॥ 8 ॥
अथवा भार्गवश्रेष्ठ दिने पूजितलक्षणे ॥
मृदुध्रुवेषु ऋक्षेषु नामकर्म विधीयते ॥9॥
तत्राप्यङ्गारकदिनं तिथिं रिक्तां च वर्जयेत् ॥
नामधेयं तु वर्णानां कर्तव्यं तु समाक्षरम् ॥2.85.1 0॥
माङ्गल्यं ब्राह्मणस्योक्तं क्षत्रियस्य बलान्वितम् ॥
वैश्यस्य धनसंयुक्तं शूद्रस्य तु जुगुप्सितम्॥11॥
2.17.m:
Beforehand, touching and caring for [the wife] should be performed by the wise;
and in the sixth or eighth [month] the parting-of-the-hair rite [is performed]; and in these three rites,
a masculine-named lunar mansion is recommended for one who desires a son:
Punarvasu, Puṣya, Hasta, Mṛgaśīrṣa, and Mūla, along with Śravaṇa,
are designated as having masculine names, and Svāti here is the seventh.
Tuesday should be avoided, and one should avoid an empty lunar day.
Before the navel-string is severed, the birth-rite should be performed by the wise;
when the ritual impurity has passed, the naming-rite is prescribed.
Or, O best of the Bhṛgus, on a day possessing auspicious marks,
under soft and fixed asterisms, the naming-rite is prescribed.
There too one should avoid Tuesday and an empty lunar day;
and the name of the social classes should be formed of an even number of syllables.
For a brahmin it is said to be auspicious, for a kṣatriya connected with strength,
for a vaiśya associated with wealth, but for a śūdra expressing disdain.

गर्भाष्टमेऽब्दे कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणस्योपनायनम् ॥
गर्भादेकादशे राज्ञः गर्भाच्च द्वादशे विशः ॥ 19 ॥
चूडाकर्मणि यः प्रोक्तः कालः सोऽत्रापि शस्यते ॥
नक्षत्राणां यथोक्तानां मुहूर्ताश्च शुभप्रदाः ॥ 2.85.20 ॥
षोडशाऽब्दे हि विप्रस्य राजन्यस्य दविविंशतिः॥
विंशतेश्च चतुष्कं तु वैश्यस्य परिकीर्तितम्॥21॥
सावित्री नातिवर्तेत अत ऊर्ध्वं निवर्तते ॥
विज्ञातव्यास्त्रयोऽप्येते यथाकालमसंस्कृताः ॥ 2 ॥
सावित्रीपतिता व्रात्या व्रात्यस्तोमक्रमादृते ॥
मुञ्जस्य बिल्वजानां च क्रमान्मौञ्जः प्रकीर्तितः॥ 23 ॥
मार्गवैयाघ्रचर्माणि वस्त्राणि व्रतचारिणाम् ॥
पर्णपिप्पलबिल्वानां क्रमाद्दण्डाः प्रकीर्तिताः॥24॥
कचदेशललाटांसतुल्याः प्रोक्ताः क्रमेण तु ॥
अवक्रा सत्वचः सर्वे नाग्निशुष्कास्तथैव च ॥ 25 ॥
2.17.m:
The initiation of a brahmin should be performed in the eighth year from conception,
of a king in the eleventh from conception, and of a vaiśya in the twelfth from conception.
The time that is stated for the tonsure-rite is recommended here as well,
as are the auspicious muhūrtas of the aforementioned asterisms.
For a brahmin [the limit] is the sixteenth year, for a kṣatriya twenty-two,
and four past twenty is proclaimed for a vaiśya.
The Sāvitrī verse does not lapse [before this]; beyond this it lapses.
All three of these should be recognized as unconsecrated if not initiated at the proper time,
fallen from the Sāvitrī, outcasts, except through the procedure of the Vrātyastoma.
Girdles made of muñja grass, [mūrvā, and hemp] are declared in order [for the three classes].
The skins of the antelope, deer, and tiger are the garments for those observing the vow.
The staffs of parṇa, pippala, and bilva are proclaimed in order;
they are stated to reach respectively up to the hair, the forehead, and the shoulder;
all of them straight, with their bark intact, and not scorched by fire.

2.17.d:
वासोपवीतकार्पासक्षौमोर्णानां यथाक्रमम् ॥
आदिमध्यावसानेषु भवच्छब्दोपलक्षितम् ॥ 26॥
प्रथमं तत्र भिक्षेत यत्र भिक्षा ध्रुवं भवेत् ॥
पूजयेद्वासुदेवं च तत्र देवं विशेषतः ॥ 27 ॥
हृषीकेशं व्रतेशं च सर्वविघ्नेश्वरं प्रभुम् ॥
यथोक्तेषु च ऋक्षेषु त्रैविद्यां कारयेद्गुरुः ॥ 28 ॥
नैवाधिकरी वेदे स्याद्विना त्रैविद्यकेन तु ॥
स्त्रीणां संस्कारमत्रोक्तं सकृत्कार्यं विजानता ॥ 29 ॥
क्षेत्रसंस्कारमेतद्धि सकृदेव विजायते ॥
संस्काराणि पिता कुर्यान्मेखलाबन्धनात्मनः ॥
मेखला बन्धनाद्यानि कार्याणि गुरुणा तथा ॥2.85.30॥
सर्वाणि कार्याणि हि लौकिकेऽग्नौ स्वकल्पमालोक्य भृगुप्रधान ॥
सर्वेषु पूजा च तथा विधेया तस्याप्रमेयस्य जनार्दनस्य॥31॥
2.17.m:
The upper garments and sacred threads are of cotton, linen, and wool in order. / [The formula] marked with the word *bhavat* should be used at the beginning, middle, and end [respectively].
He should first beg where alms are certain to be given, / and there he should especially worship Lord Vāsudeva,
Hṛṣīkeśa, the lord of vows, the powerful lord of all obstacles. / And under the constellations prescribed, the guru should initiate him into the three Vedas.
Without initiation into the three Vedas, he would not be entitled to the Veda. / The sacrament for women is declared here to be performed only once by the wise;
for this sanctification of the womb is performed only once. / The father should perform the sacraments up to the tying of the girdle; / from the tying of the girdle onward, they are likewise to be performed by the guru.
Indeed, all rites must be performed in the domestic fire according to one's own manual, O foremost of the Bhṛgus; / and in all of them, worship of that immeasurable Janārdana must likewise be performed.
